"I'd enter the contest, and be the human sacrifice for you
guys."
messages.4821:
Those three really are close. Even after an argument (...of
sorts), they still ended with smiles all around.
messages.4915:
"(The dress the handicraft club is preparing... I wonder how
it'd look on her?)"
messages.4975:
I'd be able to find out and enjoy the day after tomorrow,
apparently.
messages.5053:
After that, we drank some tea and chatted the rest of the
day away.
messages.5148: In the end, there was no real reason to come today either...
messages.5348: Once again, I returned to the home of the Shirakawas.
messages.5422:
However, there were visitors ahead of me: Mik-kun and
Tomo-chan.
messages.5483:
The three of them were discussing about the graduation
party. Apparently the handicraft club was using the dress as
bait for Kotori to advertise it.
messages.5629:
In the end, Kotori decided to participate in the Miss Kazami
Academy Contest after all.

messages.310:
The music ended, and without realizing it, my hands
instinctively clapped by themselves.
messages.408:
"That was amazing, you three. You don't sound like amateurs
at all."
messages.488:
The tone of the bass and piano, accompanied by Kotori's
clear voice, was an amazing match.
messages.570:
The vocals sounded like a free spirit among a loud, yet
calming rhythm.
messages.642:
Kotori herself may not say so, but to me, the entire tune
was a beautiful melody to my ears.
messages.759:
"...It's the last day of practice, of course we have to be
perfect."
messages.823:
Finally, Kotori gave a smile of confidence. Having just
performed like that, it's not hard to see why.
messages.913:
--"We've done it." I could tell from her smile that her
heart was saying those words to herself.
messages.1021:
Her mouth co-operating with her heart, her smile seemed
wider than ever.
messages.1182: "I can't tell that you were sick in bed just yesterday."
messages.1263: "I told you, I'm not as feeble as you think!"
messages.1319:
Having learned her lesson, she had tied herself to bed for
the entire yesterday. As a result, her first day of full
recovery was triumphant.
messages.1452:
Of course, tomorrow being the day of reckoning, it would be
worrying if they weren't ready today.
messages.1560: "But, I'm glad we made it in time..."
messages.1599: She put a hand to her chest, and breathed a sigh of relief.
messages.1651:
"Having been so sick the last few days, I wasn't sure
whether I could remain on par with the rest of you..."
messages.1735:
"If that was the case, it would've been a situation for the
school's heroine, for sure."
messages.1901: "Then, let's give a few cheers of hurray!"
messages.2019: "No real reason. Come on everyone, join your hands!"
messages.2183: "Don't worry about it. C'mon, Hurray! Hurray!"
messages.2482:
"But your allocated time for the room is up, and it's our
turn now..."
messages.2573:
Rivals in reserving the music room? In other words, maybe we
should give them a few psychological blows?
messages.2651:
Of course, a chant of hurray like we just did should be
proof enough. I nodded to him.
messages.2881:
"Kotori, will you still be going there to practice singing
today?"
messages.3035:
"Maybe you should stop it for today... standing in the wind
like that may be bad for you, just one day before."
messages.3131:
"E, Eh~... I'm not some girl standing at the beach in
twilight or anything, the wind doesn't blow much there..."
messages.3246: "Regardless, the springs winds are pretty strong."
messages.3375:
Tomo-chan lowered her eyebrow of worry, having seemed to
have convinced Kotori.
messages.3445: "Well, let's stop going for today, then?"
messages.3587:
"Then, why don't we all go to "Hana Yori Dango"? I'd treat
everyone for being such trouble the last few days."
messages.3697:
At her suggestion, Tomo-chan and Mik-kun looked at each
other at the same time, then looked back at us and shook
their heads.
messages.3790: "No thanks, we have things to do. You two go."
messages.3841: "Eh? Don't tell me you're, Kotori and I..."
messages.3922: Her laugh gave off an "of course!" aura.
messages.4013:
"Let's just say we're not worthy of a treat from Kotori.
Let's go, Tomo-chan."
messages.4187:
They left us dumbfounded, staring at their backs as their
disappeared into the horizon.
messages.4305:
"...We should move as well. I don't want to disappoint the
two of them."
messages.4459:
"But, somehow, I don't think it's obvious at all that that
would happen..."
messages.4652: I glanced at her from the side.
messages.4679:
She was looking far into the distance, not looking at
anything in particular as the sakura petals flit past her
view constantly.
messages.4793: "It's so strange, to be talking about it like this..."
messages.5013:
She had a strange smile that seemed to give the impression
that she was...lonely.
messages.5076:
"Earlier... I've told you that Mik-kun has a brother,
right?"
messages.5154: "Ahh... the one who gave Mik-kun the name she has now."
messages.5218:
"When we were kids... I was kinda jealous of Mik-kun,
because she had an older brother."
messages.5288: "Heh... in the end, it's always more fun to have a sibli--"
messages.5354: "Wait, you do have Koyomi-sensei, don't you?"
messages.5511:
"That siblings of the same sex, it's more difficult for
them..."
messages.5600: Kotori nodded, and returned her gaze to the distance.
messages.5725:
Getting impatient with herself, she gestured with her hand
round and round.
messages.5798:
"In the other case, you find that there's more of a chance
that the older person will look out for the younger one, and
such...
messages.5960: Way before, that's the same way I felt about Nemu...
messages.6022:
Kotori's probably a better judge of people than I figured
her for.
messages.6109:
"And that's for opposite sex siblnigs... for same sex... I
don't think so..."
messages.6308: Not from my own experience, but...
messages.6423:
She gave a short sigh, then her overall demeanour started
changing.
messages.6533:
"In any case, there's no way I can have an older brother
now. But it's okay, since I'm close to you."
messages.6709:
"You're the first guy I've ever been so close with, in
fact."
messages.6981:
"There's no guy I've called or written letters to... no guy
who my heart beated faster for, who I wanted to confess
to..."
messages.7122:
"But just talking like this face to face, you're the first
guy I've ever done this with."
messages.7200:
She placed her finger on her lips in thought-- I guess to
her, this was a big thing.
messages.7270: As if she's just explained a big secret she's been keeping.
messages.7387: "Hey look! There isn't many people around."
messages.7449: Kotori grabbed my hand and started walking.
messages.7527: In confusion, I let myself be dragged as I talked.
messages.7564:
All I could concentrate on was the fact that Kotori was
holding my hand.
messages.7616: It was warm, it was soft.
messages.7653: I couldn't think of anything else.
messages.7686:
Something was running circles inside my stomach, and my
heartbeat jumped several notches.
messages.7778:
Kotori stopped and turned back to me, and gave me a dazzling
smile.
messages.7885: "It's okay. We're good friends, after all!"
messages.7949: Kotori's cheeks, just like mine, were flushed with redness.
messages.8029:
I felt like I could almost hear her own quickening heartbeat
through her hand...
messages.8274: The trio's final practice session ended magnificently.
messages.8366:
As we returned, Kotori and I went to the "Hana Yori Dango"
coffeeshop.
messages.8447: On the way, Kotori talked to me about siblings.
messages.8503: I never knew Kotori was this sharp about people.

messages.162:
Unsurprisingly, it's hard to fall asleep the day before a
big event.
messages.236:
But I'm not some youngun anymore. I know when I need to go
to bed.
messages.554:
As I explored the kingdom of dreams, I came across uncharted
territory.
messages.601: "I need to get enough sleep for tomorrow."
messages.751:
It was a kid. A small girl, crying. She was wiping her eyes
with the back of her hand.
messages.838:
Looks like I'm seeing Kotori's dream--but it looks like a
sad one...
messages.980: Her apparent reply shocked me. Why can she see me...?
messages.1048:
No, no... sometime while I wasn't looking, a short person
had appeared beside me.
messages.1165:
It was grandma. The grandma who used to live next door to
us, and a self-declared witch.
messages.1229:
Man... she appears in the worst of places. Stifling a bitter
smile, I watched her nostalgic, laughing figure.
messages.1357:
In contrast to my reaction, Kotori furtively looked up at
grandma.
messages.1423:
Not surprising, really. After all, grandma is a blond,
blue-eyed foreigner. Most kids here are wary of that.
messages.1552:
"(Anyone who doesn't ride the good black ship are probably
monsters to them...)"
messages.1624:
"(Anyway, what am I talking about with this right in fromt
of me...)
messages.1692:
As my thoughts wandered away from the current situation,
grandma squatted down in front of Kotori.
messages.1856:
Her mouth's movements showed she was chewing something. Her
lips-- is that manjuu on it?
messages.1947: "That's good, that managed to stop your crying..."
messages.2024: "Kids' crying are always the most painful kind."
messages.2135:
"Oh my, you've finished it all already. Would you like some
more?"
messages.2233: Her eyes were hesitant, but her head nodded anyway.
messages.2331:
Quicker than the eye could see, she created a manjuu onto
her hand and gave it to Kotori.
messages.2437:
She gave a smile, the cute smile of a large-petaled flower.
It was a smile of true happiness.
messages.2509:
It was completely unsuited to her marshmallow-like cheeks,
still stained with tears.
messages.2796: She gave a little wave. But as soon as she turned her back--
messages.2881:
Her voice cried out sharply. It was a cry so sharp, it
would've stopped the entire world in it's tracks.
messages.2981: Once again, she squatted down to Kotori's level.
messages.3021: "P, please listen to me, grandma... I..."
messages.3083:
Her words were stuttered, as if she was choking on
something.
messages.3253:
Please listen, please listen, p-l-e-a-s-e l-i-s-t-e-n,
please listen to me. She was practically saying it as a last
resort.
messages.3360:
That's right, who would listen to some childishly-voiced
plea like that?
messages.3430: That's probably why she sounds so desperate...
messages.3469:
Even though it's to someone she's only met for the first
time...
messages.3569: "I, I can't... papa, mama, onee-chan's feelings..."
messages.3658: "E, everyone's feelings... I don't know them..."
messages.3730: "Not papa, not mama... not onee-chan... I just met them..."
messages.3827:
She interrupted herself in the middle, and started to sob
again.
messages.3908: Her father, her mother... and Koyomi-sensei?
messages.3939:
Unlike my state of confusion, grandma calmly rubbed Kotori's
head gently.
messages.4034: "If you don't know, then why don't you try to ask?"
messages.4176: Striking right to the core of the issue...
messages.4265: But Kotori still intently shook her head no.
messages.4515:
Putting the hand brushing Kotori's head back to her side,
she looked sternly at Kotori.
messages.4606:
"Sometimes, it's best not to know what everyone else is
thinking."
messages.4716: Kotori's tearful face looked up at grandma.
messages.4751:
But grandma's gaze was unwavering. This is how she earned
many enemies through her life.
messages.4967: The wind blew past, and the sakura petals started dancing.
messages.4996:
The swirling sakura petals quickly blocked me from seeing
the rest...
messages.5185: I saw a dream. A dream by Kotori, of her childhood...
messages.5228:
My grandma was in the dream as well. She was the one who
Kotori pleaded to listen to her.
messages.5339:
Her family were people she just met before, so that's why
she didn't know anything about them...

messages.215: The graduation ceremony passed without incident.
messages.248:
One by one, the speeches came from the director, the
president, the mayor, and the farewell address.
messages.297:
They talked so much about this and that, that I doubt it was
worth anything to hear them.
messages.361:
Although with the haunting BGM playing, mixing with the
solemn atmosphere, gave me some weird feelings.
messages.449:
At HR, Koyomi-sensei thanked us. (It was rare to hear her
say something so serious. In my mind, I returned the thanks
as well.)
messages.574:
After the ceremony ended, with the amount of tears that was
being shed, you would've thought that this was really the
end.
messages.703:
Relatively speaking though, we were just going to the main
school; our classmates might change, but things'd still be
the same.
messages.808:
I didn't have such deep emotions about it; the "graduation"
from the affiliated school was simply a step on the
staircase of life.
messages.939:
If I were to be perfectly honest, I had no interest
whatsoever in the graduation party.
messages.982:
Those kind of events have two types of characters: the
mains, and the supporting cast. I, and most, were clearly
the latter.
messages.1050:
While the mains would dominate proceedings, gather all the
attention, and basically lay waste to the entire event.
messages.1177:
Having to play to those roles... that was more trouble than
I wanted to handle right now.
messages.1261:
Instead, I started to search for a deserted place to just
hang around.
messages.1371:
And the first thing I thought of for a "deserted place", was
here.
messages.1441:
Right behind the building bustling excitement. I guess it
doesn't really have the best atmosphere.
messages.1537:
But with the preparation and broadcasting room right inside
the gym, while it was noisy within, it was nice and quiet
outside.
messages.1712: "Tskishiro... looking after that plant again, today?"
messages.1802:
"It's the graduation party, you know. Don't you have anyone
to look around the place with?"
messages.1910: Tsukishiro shook her head, left and right.
messages.2002:
"Me? I think the graduation party is more trouble than it's
worth. I came here to just rest in some deserted place."
messages.2121: "Well, I also came here since I thought you'd be here."
messages.2234:
"Yeah. Today was the graduation ceremony after all, I wanted
to talk with you for a bit."
messages.2347: Tsukishiro was nervously playing with her lips.
messages.2390:
She seemed to want to say "Senpai, congratulations on your
graduation", but she just couldn't get it out.
messages.2572: "Alright! Tsukishiro-san, found it! Let's go play!!"
messages.2640:
Suddenly, a shadowy figure appeared and grabbed Tsukishiro's
arm from the side.
messages.2761:
"Tsukishiro-san's under my custody now! I'm going to take
her to the hot springs table tennis club and eat banana milk
sundaes!"
messages.3164:
Tsukishiro, for once, let herself be caught up in Miharu's
infectious energy, and flusteredly replied with her assent.
messages.3272: "Okay! Then, let's go! Any last words?"
messages.3338:
You're not going to a battleground, what do you mean by last
words...
messages.3514:
Tsukishiro seemed like she wanted to take off her gloves,
but with Miharu holding on to one of her hands, she
couldn't.
messages.3786:
With considerable difficulty, Tsukishiro finally managed to
say it.
messages.3890: "Now then, let's go the sacred land of bananas!"
messages.3976:
Tsukishiro, swallowed up by Miharu, was then whisked away to
who-knows-where.
messages.4089:
With Tsukishiro gone, this place can really be called
deserted.
messages.4161: The only things left were Tsukishiro's plant, and the wind.
messages.4223:
I took my usual seat on a block, and gazed at the scenery
before me.
messages.4508:
"Look at yourself. Anyone would be scared by you suddenly
appearing out of nowhere."
messages.4630: "...Anyway, what do you want with me?"
messages.4693: "Well, I have something to say to you."
messages.4797:
"To be honest, I wanted to keep quiet about it, but in the
end, I couldn't."
messages.4945: "Well... I'm not going to the main school."
messages.4992:
"? ......After you took all this trouble to come here? Then
why did you transfer in the first place?"
messages.5098:
"Unfortunately for you, that's a secret. One I'd carry with
me to my grave."
messages.5241:
"...I'm not gonna tell you. And after next week, there may
be times where I won't be home for long periods... don't
worry."
messages.5392:
"Well, there's a lot of complicated things happening right
now."
messages.5462:
"Things that you can't do yourself? Is there anything I can
help with?"
messages.5615:
"...Stuuupid, I just don't like hearing tragic herione
acts."
messages.5719:
"Sorry! But this is something I have to do myself, whether I
succeed or not."
messages.5797: Sakura spoke with little giggles tempering her speech.
messages.5844:
A laugh that semed to indicate that she could see through my
heart.
messages.5902:
"Well, if you feel that way, and since you told me
beforehand... I guess I won't be as worried as I could've
been."
messages.6038:
"Yeah, that's why I decided against not telling you, and
came here. Really, don't worry about me."
messages.6316: "Is this flower, by any chance, a Roskill Lavender?"
messages.6434:
"Don't try to say it if you don't know... I said, Roskill
Lavender."
messages.6518:
She pointed to the plant Tsukishiro was growing, as she
spoke.
messages.6655:
"Yep! It's a flower that only grows in cold climates in
Europe."
messages.6755:
"It's the least you can expect from someone with a
bachelor's degree in botany."
messages.6817: "You should be careful about just saying that so casually."
messages.6905:
"This is strange, though. A flower like Roskill Lavender
shouldn't be able to grow in Japan's climate..."
messages.6983:
"Even if the person growing it is putting all her heart and
soul in it?"
messages.7108:
"Yeah, it's a 2nd year student, named Tsukishiro. She was
here earlier, but got dragged away by Miharu."
messages.7209:
"And she's been watching over it practically every day. With
dedication like that, it shouldn't be impossible, right?"
messages.7344:
"Not quite... Roskill Lavenders are extremely delicate. A
sudden change in Ntemperature will cause it to wither."
messages.7513:
"Because of that, you won't ever see Roskill Lavenders
growing in mountaineous regions, or in valleys."
messages.7628:
Sakura's attention was entirely focused on the plant. Her
eyebrows were raised, as she emitted a low "hmm" noise."
messages.7700:
"No matter how much effort a person puts into raising it, it
won't just grow that easily."
messages.7843:
"Well... not definitely. But it'd still take more than just
effort."
messages.7921: She continued her observation of the plant as she talked.
messages.8055:
"For example, it requires the temperature to remain
constant, like it has been for the past few weeks."
messages.8202:
"Like I said, I DO specialize in botany. This bachelor's
degree isn't just for show."
messages.8315:
Sakura suddenly looked up from her squatting position, and
stared at me.
messages.8411:
"But, I don't think this will bloom. It may be harsh on the
person growing it, but I think it'd start withering very
soon."
messages.8582:
"Because it's true. You can see it easily by the state of
the stalk and the leaves."
messages.8713:
"Although, just the fact that this plant exists in such a
climate is worthy of further investigation by experts."
messages.8817:
"There won't be much difference in how well you grow it now;
it seems destined to wither away."
messages.8946:
"While certainly, it'd have it's uses in biological
experiments..."
messages.8977:
"No! You can't! Not while there's still someone giving it
her all trying to make that grow..."
messages.9108:
Sakura hopped up from her squatting position, sulking like a
child.
messages.9168:
She then started scraping off the dirt from her skirt,
muttering TO herself whether it looks okay.
messages.9328: White smoke was pouring out of the school building.
messages.9463: "Whatever it is, we better go take a look."
messages.9582: I left Sakura, heading for the source of the white smoke.
messages.9676:
"Seeing a Roskill Lavender growing here... how very
strange."
messages.9915:
Today was graduation day. All the hullabaloo of receiving
our raduation certificates and so on, moved something inside
me.
messages.9997:
Feeling slightly emotional, I went to see Tsukishiro, but
she was eventually whisked away by Miharu.
messages.10112:
At least she managed to tell me "Senpai, congratulations on
your graduation", which made me happy.
messages.10196:
After that, Sakura appeared. She came to tell me that she
wouldn't be ascending to the main school like the rest of
us.
messages.10288:
First Nemu, now Sakura, why does everyone seem to be leaving
my side...
messages.10364:
Sakura, upon seeing Tskushiro's plant nearby, was surprised
by it.
messages.10434:
That plant was a Roskill Lavender, a plant that grows only
in cold cliamtes. It isn't supposed to be able to grow in
places like Japan.
messages.10545:
Apparently, the fact that the flower grew this much has been
down to luck, and the chance of it growing any further was
nil.
messages.10654: So Tsukishiro's actions... are all going to be for naught...

messages.277: I gripped my graduation certificate tightly.
messages.392: "Show your true feelings already, you bastard."
messages.483:
A passing student somehow got entwined in my monologue, like
a poor sap into Shishido Baiken's scythe.
messages.612:
As I watched the back of the guy running away, I gave a
sigh.
messages.680: It was an enoyable three years.
messages.713:
Thinking about all the memories I have of this time was
enough to get my eyebrows heated up.
messages.824:
I'd still have to stare at this scenery of Kazami Academy
again soon...
messages.1107:
At Kotori's sudden appearance, my pulse suddenly stared
racing.
messages.1168:
"Anyway, what's depressing? It IS the long-awaited
graduation ceremony and party..."
messages.1246:
Pointing to the work being done outside using my graduation
certificate.
messages.1367:
With a depressed look on her face, she pointed to several
students loitering in a corridor.
messages.1442:
"Those students who were shedding so many tears just now are
laughing again."
messages.1516:
"Ahh, when those who exhaust all their tears and start
laughing?"
messages.1650:
I looked at Kotori bewildered for a moment, then in an
instant, I realized what she was trying to say.
messages.1769:
Then right after you give him sweets to eat, he laughs
again--.
messages.1878:
My mind, which was flying like a kite, quickly returned back
to earth.
messages.2009:
I opened the pamphlet for the graduation party. I thought
the trio's performance was quite a bit later.
messages.2109: "No no. I mean the handicraft club's--"
messages.2179: "Ahh, here you are. Brother, and Shirkawa-sa...Kotori."
messages.2361: "Ah, uhn, congratulations to you as well."
messages.2402: "What's up, Nemu? What've I done now?"
messages.2490:
"Why are you answering like a criminal? Don't make me worry
too much about the graduation party events now..."
messages.2753: Taking a short glance at Kotori, she continued.
messages.2813:
"Shi--Kotori's entering the contest, sponsored by the
handicrafts club..."
messages.2879:
"Ooh, your sources are quick. Just as expected from the
discplinary committee--"
messages.2941: "...Wait a minute, don't tell me you're entering too?"
messages.3029:
Her forehead wrinkling, Nemu responded in the negative
immediately.
messages.3110:
"No way, not ever again, over my dead body. Not that
embarassing thing..."
messages.3209:
"...I didn't know you felt that badly about that Christmas,
Nemu."
messages.3299:
"...Of course an outsider wouldn't be able to, and shouldn't
pretend to pat my shoulder and understand."
messages.3363: She wiggled my hand off her shoulder.
messages.3457: "But anyway... is it really okay to enter the contest?"
messages.3508:
There was a surprising amount of worry on her face as she
constantly switched her gaze between the two of us.
messages.3598: "It can't be helped. This was the bargaining chip."
messages.3841:
"It's irritating. But in the end, it's about give and take,
50-50."
messages.3920: "If that's how it is... I guess there's really no choice."
messages.4225:
"Oh, I almost forgot! I have unfinished business to settle!
I have to go now, busy busy..."
messages.4319: Oyoy Nemu, you sound like you're reading off a script.
messages.4385: "I, if you will, excuse me, both of you."
messages.4462:
As always, the easy-to-read girl flusteredly ran down the
corridor.
messages.4662:
I looked at Nemu's back as well, surpressing the urge to
sneak a peek sideways.
messages.4740: "...Well, I'm proud to have her as my sister."
messages.4771:
It is a graduation now. If I wasn't honest any other time,
now would be one where I should.
messages.4933: "Aww, you mean it's not envy on a grand scale?"
messages.5388:
I came across Kotori and Nemu along the way. The former
reminded me that the contest was coming soon, and wanted me
to go watch it...

messages.154:
Did this school really have this many people? That's what I
asked myself as I gazed over the numerous male students.
messages.294:
All the giggling and gaggling around the room made my head
throb.
messages.383:
I sighed heavily, and looked towards the stage. A second
heavy sigh followed. On the curtains was a large banner:
messages.539:
It was just the same as last Christmas. And just like last
Christmas, I didn't want to be around such a huge gathering
of people.
messages.621:
"(About the only thing to look forward to is the girls that
actually come out...)"
messages.670:
Where all the boys suddenly learn exactly where their brain
is located.
messages.960: "Our deepest apologies for the long wait."
messages.1005:
Swept away by the wave of noise, the apology was barely
heard by the masses.
messages.1066:
"But now, we are proud to present you the Miss Kazami
Academy Contest, sponsored by the handicrafts club!"
messages.1153:
A series of shouts of approval could be heard from the
audience.
messages.1211:

"What club activities do you participate in? The handicrafts

Now, absolutely everyone's gaze was fixated straight on

messages.6099:
In the massive room, the sound of my footsteps echoed

Complete silence. I could hear and feel nothing from the

At once, the noise returned--angry ones? In any case, it was

I could feel the kickback from all the Kotori fanboys in the

...Despite saying it several times, it was constantly

"...I'm not an eloquent speaker, so I have to show you in my

...quickly snapped back to reality, as a hellish roar cried

even for me, though. I'd settle for ten thousand!"
messages.2661:
"Same difference. You can make that kind of wish come true
by working your butt off and spending your earnings on it,
anyway."
messages.2781:
"...That'd take around 400,000 yen. Not so attainable for me
right now..."
messages.2847:
Miharu sighed with despair, seeing her dreams of bananas
fade away.
messages.2895:
Right now, it's an unattainable dream, but in the future,
that cost may well be possible to fund.
messages.2973: ...Although spending 400,000 yen on bananas is crazy.
messages.3031:
"She should tell us what she wished for... maybe we could
make it come true?"
messages.3162: "You don't think it'd be way too much for us to fulfill?"
messages.3218:
"You mean, like, taking over the world, or flying through
the air, or producing wagashis from your hand when you
want?"
messages.3349:
"...You think Tsukishiro would grow that plant so
wholeheartedly, to wish for such silly things like that?"
messages.3513:
"Although I'd be really happy if I could make a banana
appear in my hand whenever I want."
messages.3587: "...It's not as good as it sounds."
messages.3710: I cleared my throat. Hope she didn't notice...
messages.3830:
"We won't be able to get closer to Tsukishiro-san at this
rate, huh..."
messages.3908:
"That's not true... I'm sure she wants to become closer to
us as well."
messages.4030:
"Why are you being so feeble now? What happened to that
overbearing energeticness?"
messages.4131: "Even I get a little depressed sometimes..."
messages.4197: "...Saying it yourself, you'd get no help from me."
messages.4255: Miharu giggled at my straight reply.
messages.4300:
"All we need, is a little chance to break through her
shell."
messages.4390: "And help heal the deep, deep wound in her heart?"
messages.4431:
"No matter how deep it is, it can always be healed. It might
just take time."
messages.4531: "I guess so. Someday, we'd all be good friends for sure."
messages.4646: I threw another of the banana cookies into my mouth.
messages.4749:
"Okay then! Let's go to Tsukishiro-san's place! I'm sure
she's bored, during this spring vacation!"
messages.4894:
"Why not? It's not even 2 PM yet. It's not an odd time to
visit, and I don't think we'd be bothers there."
messages.5001:
With a clenched fist and a war cry, Miharu leapt up from the
sofa.
messages.5155:
"Too bad, your "troublesome" doesn't have any effect on me.
I saw it way in advance, after all!"
messages.5272:
Sighing, I grabbed Miharu's hand, and dragged her out and
towards Tsukishiro's place.
messages.5435:
"Ah, this would be Asakura-sama and Amakase-sama. Welcome.
--Oh, where might Suginami-sama be?"
messages.5651: Miharu laughed embarassedly at my sarcasm.
messages.5739: Seiba-san left his seat, and came back shortly.
messages.5793:
He opened the envelope, and read the contents, nodding and
making "hmm" sounds.
messages.5865:
"Is something wrong? That letter seems to be,
interesting..."
messages.5953:
"Ah, I was just pondering the coincidental timing of it
all."
messages.6024:
Seiba-san handed us several photos that came with the
envelope.
messages.6099:
"It seems Suginami-sama has been travelling indeed. I am
quite envious of him."
messages.6197:
The picture was of Suginami standing in a main street in
England, eating fish and chips.
messages.6296: "Where did he go at this time..."
messages.6335:
That irritating grin raked within me, as I glared at his
picture.
messages.6427: "He will return to Hatsunejima tomorrow, it appears."
messages.6572:
That statement was as true as could be. It's useless to
think about it, so that'd be the end of that.
messages.6753:
"Unfortunately, the mistress has went shopping today. I
believe she intends to purchase more records."
messages.7001:
"I will inform the mistress that the both of you came to
visit her... please come back any time you wish."
messages.7223: "I guess I should be heading back too."
messages.7325:
"Your house is kinda far away from here, and I'd only be
more trouble, so..."
messages.7520:
"Actually, I'm going out to eat for dinner tonight, so I
need to head back early to prepare."
messages.7636:
"Do you want to come too, senpai? I think my parents
wouldn't mind; they'd welcome you, in fact!"
messages.7820: "That "troublesome" had a serious "troublesome" feel to it."
messages.7977:
"See you later, senpai! I'd come visit you soemtime next
week, too!"
messages.8055:
Miharu gave me a quick bow, then ran off in the opposite
direction.
messages.8150:
"Pah, and I thought spring break was for spending time with
friends."
messages.8201:
Let's see... Tsukishiro isn't around, Miharu went home,
Suginami is in England (or so he claims)... that leaves no
one.
messages.8376:
That's the release date for all the newest manga issues. I
better hurry up and check it out.
messages.8444:
Making sure I had something in my wallet, I entered the
bookshop in the shopping district.
messages.8559:
All the popular mangas were stacked up in a mountain of
books, and surrounded by people.
messages.8637:
I grabbed one from near the base of the "mountain". At this
rate, they'd all be gone within a few hours.
messages.8727:
With the bought manga snugly under my arm, I continued
wandering around the shopping district.
messages.8781:
If I walk around here long enough, maybe I'd bump into
someone I know, and we could do something less boring.
messages.8888:
--And right on cue, Tsukishiro was sitting on a bench I was
talking towards.
messages.9056:
"Ah, I heard it from Seiba-san. Miharu and I went over in
the afternoon to visit, and heard that you were out
shopping."
messages.9220:
"Shall we head home together? You are done with your
shopping, right?"
messages.9278:
Beside Tsukishiro was a paper bag, with what looked like a
record sitting inside.
messages.9393: Tsukishiro shook her head from side to side.
messages.9520: Tsukishiro's eyes wandered over to her foot.
messages.9654: Tsukishiro looked back up at my face, and nodded.
messages.9701: "How much does it hurt? You can't walk by yourself?"
messages.9812:
She swung her leg back and forth a bit, with her face
constantly grimacing in pain.
messages.9899: I removed her shoes, and slowly peeled off her socks.
messages.9957: That smooth, white ankle was swollen, slightly red.
messages.10002:
"If you don't move it around too much, it should heal fully
by tomorrow or so."
messages.10088:
"I'm going to that convenience store to buy a compress. Wait
a bit, okay?"
messages.10199:
I entered the convenience store just across the street, and
quickly bought a compress and some bandages."
messages.10316: I placed the compress on her ankle.
messages.10411: "You have to keep it cool to keep the swelling down."
messages.10487:
"It'd be best if I carry you on my back, home... do you mind
that?"
messages.10557: She shook her head back and forth, no.
messages.10655:
"It's okay, there's no way I could've left you here like
this anyway."
messages.10725:
I threw Tsukishiro's sock and shoe, and the manga I bought,
into the convenience store bag. I then squatted in front of
her.
messages.10875: With a nod, she slowly climbed on top of my body.
messages.10931: I stood up, feeling her delicate body on my back.
messages.11060:
Tiny arms were lightly hitting my back. I quickly let my
arms drop to the side; the arms that were formerly holding
her behind.
messages.11184:
"A, ahh... I didn't... mean to touch your behind... not
there..."
messages.11262: Hearing her quiet yelps made me extremely embarassed.
messages.11324:
Stumbling back and forth with my words, a soft voice lilted
into my ears.
messages.11438: Her mouth was at the tip of my ear, whispering.
messages.11527: "Y, yeah... it was. Let's just head back."
messages.11587:
I took the path through the park, unusable by vehicles, to
go home.
messages.11751: "What kind of record did you buy?"
messages.11826:
"Ahhh, I don't know him either. All those orchestra music
are foreign to me."
messages.12056:
"Well, don't worry about it. I'm glad enough to see you
doing better... besides your leg, anyway."
messages.12166:
She really is weak at talking in the end; her words were
always preceded by a moment of hesistation.
messages.12268: She'd probably be more comfortable in a quiet environment...
messages.12317: I decided to stop blabbering, and quietly continued walking.
messages.12411: We emerged from the park, and into Sakura Avenue.
messages.12442:
Having walked down this path so many times on the way to
school, it felt familiar somehow.
messages.12508: A voice then called out to me.
messages.12537: I couldn't tell what it was saying.
messages.12572:
More than actually being able to hear it, I could feel it
flowing through me.
messages.12708: What is the thing flowing through my body so rapidly?
messages.12879: My eyes were suddenly enveloped in a sea of black.
messages.12912:
I couldn't see a thing, but I could feel something deep
within the darkness.
messages.12966: It was the voice I heard from before.
messages.13041: "No, no! What I wanted wasn't this dumb doll!"
messages.13112: "I want to have friends! To make friends!"
messages.13164: "I hate you, hate you! I hate father, I hate mother!"
messages.13228: "I hate the circus! I hate everyone!"
messages.13282:
"Piros can't say anything, he can't talk to me about
anything!"
messages.13355:
"I want mother and father to play with me, to read books to
me! I don't want them to go to the circus!"
messages.13460: "They don't play with me... mother and father should die!!"
messages.13530: The voice of a tiny girl.
messages.13555: A voice that sounded like it's been crying for a long time.
messages.13650:
I suddenly recovered consciousness, and found myself still
walking on the usual Sakura Avenue to school.
messages.13731:
Tsukishiro was sleeping, her rhythmic breathing almost
hypnotic.
messages.13785: That must've been Tsukishiro's voice just now...
messages.13851: Seiba-san's words came flooding back into my head.
messages.13960:
"A doll, which could not even speak, was not enough to heal
the mistress's heart."
messages.14043:
"The mistress, in the end, became filled with anger at her
parents, and threw a temper tantrum at them."
messages.14109: In the end, the circus was never meant for her...
messages.14163:
"Kyouji-sama and Sophie-sama were distracted by the
mistress's harshness, and during a performance, met with a
terrible accident. They did not survive."
messages.14247: Tsukishiro then thought that it was her fault...
messages.14305:
"Since then, the mistress would no longer let her true
feelings be known to others."
messages.14420:
Killing her parents, with her own words. That was what she
thought she had done.
messages.14505:
"Perhaps whenever the mistress opens her mouth, the memories
of that incident flood back."
messages.14592:
"The mistress appears to be deathly afraid of ever hurting
anyone else with her own words again."
messages.14751:
No matter what she could say to us, Miharu and I wouldn't
take it badly at all...
messages.14813:
Tsukishiro's parents couldn't have wanted her to become this
way.
messages.14869:
It's not definite that it's Tsukishiro's fault that they met
with the accident, after all.
messages.14947:
But I'm sure they wouldn't have wanted to die, and leave
their only daughter so distressed, either.
messages.15085:
Her real parents are no longer with us as well. Yet now,
she's living her life, and working hard to make her dreams
come true.
messages.15177:
She said after all, that she still had me and my parents,
which left me a little embarassed.
messages.15255: I want Tsukishiro to notice that too.
messages.15292: That Miharu, Suginami... and I, are all here.
messages.15331:
We're always worrying about her, wanting to get closer to
her.
messages.15434: But, she just couldn't get the words out of her mouth.
messages.15475:
So perhaps, that's why she got a doll to communicate to
others for her.
messages.15560: I wanted to tell her all the feelings I had just now.
messages.15652:
But all I got in reply, was the steady breathing of the
sleeping Tsukishiro.
messages.15865: Apparently, Miharu was very worried about Tsukishiro.
messages.15923:
To Miharu, so desperate to become Tsukishiro's friend,
hearing that she was still depressed must've been painful
for her.
messages.16020:
We went to Tsukishiro's house to try and get closer to her,
but unfortunately, she went out, and we couldn't see her.
messages.16141:
Having done the best we can, Miharu and I seperated. I ended
up going to the shopping district.
messages.16209:
There, I met Tsukishiro, who was heading back from her
shopping. She apparently injured her leg.
messages.16289: I carried her on my back, all the way home.
messages.16330:
On the way, the sleeping Tsukishiro's memories of the past,
and feelings of loneliness, coarsed through my body.
messages.16445:
Tsukishiro, you're not alone. Miharu, myself, and even
Suginami are all ehre.
messages.16515: I whispered that to the sleeping Tsukishiro, on my back.

messages.181: ...That Suginami. Where the hell has he been?
messages.239: I received another souvenir from him yesterday...
messages.325: A giant "Welcome!" in Japanese was written on it.
messages.393: The Eiffel Tower is supposed to be in France...
messages.438:
Well, I suppose it doesn't matter to me where on earth that
idiot is.
messages.516:
He once told me with a straight face that "Last week, I
visited some relatives on Mars", and I replied "How was
it?".
messages.654: The cellphone in my pocket suddenly started vibrating.
messages.734: Pressing a few buttons on the cellphone, I opened the mail.
messages.779:
"Hm, hm... "I in fact have one more souvenir to give you.
You'd be delighted with it. So come to the park right
now"...eh?"
messages.884:
Like hell. I'm not going to go out in the middle of the
night to receive some souvenir of England with "Made In
Asia" on it.
messages.986:
Just as I was about to close the mail folder, another one
arrived.
messages.1050:
"Now what? "P.S: If you don't come, you'd regret it for the
rest of your life"... oh really?"
messages.1118:
That's ridiculous... using such grandoise words almost made
my heart stop.
messages.1231: I stood up, and returned the cellphone to my pocket.
messages.1280:
Looks like I'm going to just go along with his expectations
again...
messages.1414: "I'd walk slowly, it'd be better if I'm late."
messages.1457: Talking to myself in bitternress, I headed out of the house.
messages.1543: Another souvenir? What does he want with me about it.
messages.1601:
If I don't come, I'd regret it for the rest of my life?
That's old hat.
messages.1692: Calling me out specially, at this time of the night.
messages.1737: He may be an idiot, but he's not dumb.
messages.1782:
Pulling myself together, I headed out into the curtain of
darkness, preparing to meet Suginami.
messages.1999:
For some reason, Suginami called me out in the middle of the
night.
messages.2038:
I had a bad feeling with whatever he wanted me for, but I
headed out as per his expectations anyway.
messages.2165: What on earth is that guy thinking...

messages.259: I gazed at the white clouds above.
messages.309:
I was lying on a bed, watching the pure white clouds roll
by.
messages.358: Suginami's face then popped into my view.
messages.424: "Don't worry. Leave the rest to me."
messages.465: A serious face, very unlike him.
messages.517: "You just stay here and be a good boy... understand?"
messages.644:
"I'll head for Tsukishiro-jou's location now, then... it's
time for her to find out."
messages.747: I couldn't move from my bed.
messages.787: Suginami's figure quickly disappeared from my vision.
messages.836: Miharu will probably cover for me now...
messages.1111: "This is as serious as it gets, after all..."
messages.1148:
From now on, in Asakura-senpai's place, Miharu will cover
the following of Suginami.
messages.1222:
Suginami-senpai was running past junctions and streets, and
I did my best to follow him.
messages.1298: Shortly after, Tsukishiro's home came into view.
messages.1371:
"Hah, hahh... Suginami-senpai, wouldn't a taxi be faster? To
get to Tsukishiro-san's place..."
messages.1493:
"True. Considering the circumstances, we must do everything
we can to extend what little time we have."
messages.1563:
As he spoke, he slowed down his speed, and hailed a nearby
taxi.
messages.1656: "Hah, hahh... Suginami-senpai, you run really fast..."
messages.1714: "I cannot wait for any puppy. Every second is vital."
messages.1794:
Despite running all the way from the hospital to here,
Suginami-senpai didn't seem to even sweat one drop.
messages.1900:
We implored the taxi driver to go faster, and the taxi
increased it's speed bit by bit.
messages.1986:
But Suginami-senpai still seemed nervous and fidgety,
tapping his finger on his knee irratatedly.
messages.2064:
It can't be helped... it's such a serious amtter involving
his best friend.
messages.2122: When I heard it myself, I was so shocked as well...
messages.2182:
I wanted to go straight to the hospital, but Suginami-senpai
said that Tsukishiro still hadn't heard, and rushed towards
her home.
messages.2305:
The taxi was moving even faster than the speed limit here,
yet my heart was still pleading it to go faster and faster.
messages.2523: "I know. You better not slow me down."
messages.2687: "W, what in the name of...!? What did you just say!?"
messages.2812: "Call Tsukishiro-jou as fast as possible, Sebastian."
messages.2933:
Seiba-san hurried up the stairs, and called for
Tsukishiro-san.
messages.3059: Tsukishiro-san looked at us with a confused face.
messages.3144: "Tsukishiro-jou, listen to me calmly and carefully..."
messages.3229: "Asakura met with an accident... a traffic accident."
messages.3306: Tsukishiro-san inhaled suddenly, and leaned forward.
messages.3371:
"He's in the hospital right now. I thought you may not have
known, so we came here as fast as we could."
messages.3504:
I heard Tsukishiro swallow deeply, as she digested what
Suginami said.
messages.3593: "Tsukishiro-san, let's go, to where Asakura-senpai is..."
messages.3715:
At that moment, Tsukishiro-san jumped up and dashed towards
the entranceway.
messages.3871:
Even the ever-calm Seiba-san's face had hardened with shock,
as he questioned Suginami-senpai.
messages.3949:
Suginami-senpai, simply, slowly and wordlessly, nodded to
him.
messages.4129: "Alright. Please take care of the mistress."
messages.4272: "Puppy, we're going to chase after Tsukishiro-jou."
messages.4374: We hurried out of the mansion, and looked for the taxi.
messages.4465: "Dear puppy... did you tell the taxi to wait for us?"
messages.4609: "Ugh, what's done is done... Tsukishiro-jou, can you run?"
messages.4678:
Tsukishiro-san, with a quick nod, ran off in the direction
of the hospital.
messages.4801: "It's the Mizukoshi Hospital! Do you know where it is?"
messages.4840: Without slowing her pace, Tsukishiro-san nodded in reply.
messages.4881:
Her speed was so amazing, that it was leaving even
Suginami-senpai in the dust.
messages.5001:
I guess the stamina power of bananas has reached it's
limit...
messages.5072:
"There's a bicycle at Asakura's house! The key's in the
mailbox!"
messages.5178:
Just as Suginami-senpai said, there was a bicycle at
Asakura's house. I borrowed it for a short while, and headed
onwards.
messages.5297:
"I'd be fine, just watch for Tsukshiro-jou.... ugh... looks
like I'd be there late..."
messages.5384:
Tsukishiro-san's pace was blazingly quick, but with me
pedaling with all I had, I managed to catch up to her.
messages.5479:
The training she received at the circus when she was a child
really hasn't gone to waste.
messages.5561:
I wanted to reach where senpai was faster as well, but my
feet couldn't pedal any faster than they were now...
messages.5678:
"Haah, haah, haah, Tsukishiro-san... do you... want to get
on...?"
messages.5781:
Then, tilting her body slightly forward, somehow moved up a
gear and accelerated.
messages.5959:
Tsukishiro-san constantly repeated Asakura-senpai's name in
between her quick breaths.
messages.6025:
She's really worried... just looking at her pained face,
made my chest tighten up as well.
messages.6252:
Moving as quickly as we humanly could, we reached the
hospital.
messages.6325:
"Excuse me... may I know which ward Asakura-san is staying
in...?"
messages.6562:
With Suginami-senpai's guidance, we entered Asakura-senpai's
hospital room.
messages.6702:
Asakura-senpai appeared to be unconscious, lying in bed in a
private room.
messages.6802:
The realization that he was in accident was beginning to
sink in.
messages.6942:
Tsukishiro-san pushed me out of the way from behind, and
rushed over to Asakura-senpai's side.
messages.7127: "O, oy, Tsukishiro-jou... don't shake him like that!"
messages.7263:
Tsukishiro-san's voice was unusually strong, filled with
emotion.
messages.7386: "...Don't die, I, I.. I don't want you to die!"
messages.7478:
She spoke strongly, firing off what she wanted to say and
not holding back.
messages.7535:
Tsukishiro-san was finally speaking, with all her heart, her
own feelings.
messages.7661:
"...I... Senpai, I... I love you! I want you by my side
forever, never going away!"
messages.8105:
"Hold it! I said we'd help to heal a person's heart
problems, but I don't remember promising to help romantic
pursuits!"
messages.8377: "I've seen enough... I can't take much more of this."
messages.8454:
"Why am I, of all people, helping with Asakura's love
affairs..."
messages.8641: "Oh boy... now this is what I call awkward."
messages.8680:
Still lying under the sheets, I lifted my body into a
seating position.
messages.8764:
"Well, we fulfilled the objective anyway, so I suppose it's
alright."
messages.8857: "...Um, may I know what is going on?"
messages.9089:
"The plan would've had a much higher chance of failure, if
the dear puppy knew the truth."
messages.9236:
"Suginami talked to me yesterday. "I know a lowerclassman
with a heart problem. I want to try and save her."... was
what he said."
messages.9373:
"So, I talked with my father about it, and managed to get
him to loan one empty room. I promised it to Suginami last
evening."
messages.9548:
"Sorry, Tsukishiro. It's as she says. I didn't get caught in
any accident. I'm still as healthy as ever."
messages.9634: The operation is over, it seems.
messages.9661:
"It was Suginami's plan. He thought that you wouldn't just
be able to start communicating your own feelings by
yourself."
messages.9774:
"What was needed, was a bigger push, shock treatment... you
could say."
messages.9873:
"W, w, w, wait a minute here! So Suginami and Asakura-senpai
were lying to all of us!?"
messages.10037:
"T, this isn't a joking matter! We were so worried about
you! Right, Tsukishiro-san!?"
messages.10246:
"This is horrible! Completely uncalled for! Terrible!
Atrocious!"
messages.10544:
"...I'm glad Senpai's fine... that Asakura-senpai's still
here..."
messages.10641: Tears were rapidly dropping from Tsukishiro's eyes.
messages.10697: I broughy my hand up, wiping them from her soft face.
messages.10792: "I'm sorry, Tsukishiro. I didn't mean to trick you..."
messages.10897:
"And, thank you, Tsukishiro... I'm happy to hear your true
feelings."
messages.11006:
"Ha ha ha, Tsukishiro-jou! Do you not realize that you just
spoke your feelings through your own mouth?"
messages.11201:
"Isn't it a good feeling, to say what you truly feel
yourself, to the one you love?"
messages.11356:
Her tears had stopped. Replacing them, on her face, was a
beautiful smile.
messages.11480:
"H, hold on! It's fine with Tsukishiro-san, but what about
me? Why did you deceive me? Why did you get me involved?"
messages.11634:
"Well, to trick your enemies, you must first trick your
allies, you could say..."
messages.11705:
"But, but... grrr, I cannot accept this! I demand
compensation, in the form of 1 million bananas!"
messages.11825: "...My dear puppy. What is today's date?"
messages.11900:
"March... ah, it's April today... ermm, April 1st....
ahhhh!"
messages.12115: Until he said it, I didn't realize either...
messages.12195:
"Now then, let's leave the young ones alone. It won't do
good to be crowded now."
messages.12306:
"...So this was all I had to do? A tiny tiny role, isn't
it?"
messages.12437:
"No no, without Mizukoshi's cooperation, this operation
would never even have achieved reality."
messages.12570:
"...So my role was to help a girl confess to Asakura in
confusion?"
messages.12674:
"...Um, Senpai... I think? I'm sorry for being the source of
the trouble..."
messages.12781:
"Eh, ah, um, Tsukishiro-san, was it? It's fine. I don't have
any problems. This was for your benefit, so..."
messages.12896: Mako flapped her hand up and down, like a bird.
messages.12980:
"It should be okay to use the room for a little longer...
don't let the idiot extend it too long, though."
messages.13127:
"You, if you don't answer her properly, I won't ever forgive
you. Remember that!"
messages.13294:
"Perhaps it is time for us to leave. Let's go, Mizukoshi,
puppy."
messages.13358: Suginami opened the door back to the hospital.
messages.13506: "Yes, yes, we'd hear you out outside..."
messages.13577:

awhile; Sakura.
messages.7520:
She had left to take care of something suddenly before, and
after this, wouldn't be coming back for awhile again.
messages.7625: But, Sakura had something she wanted to ask me.
messages.7670: That is, how the Roskill Lavender was doing.
messages.7719:
It was a flower that should've had no hope left. After some
conversation, I found out she had taken a stalk before the
storm, to research.
messages.7846:
I left Sakura behind, and went to look for Alice. I took her
by the hand, and dashed off to behind the gym.
messages.7938:
Standing proudly, there-- a beautiful flower of the Roskill
Lavender.
messages.8008:
According to Alice, it doesn't actually grant wishes when it
blooms, but instead, blooms when wishes are granted.
messages.8117:
Despite that, I still offered my wish to the Roskill
Lavender.
messages.8173: "I want to be together with Alice, always."

messages.319:
The throngs of students started packing up to go home, at
Koyomi-sensei's signal.
messages.375: That's it for school for today.
messages.406: I took a nice, long stretch.
messages.433: I'll go check on how Tamaki's doing.
messages.468: Those two new girls didn't seem very comfortable...
messages.589:
"I couldn't believe my ears when I heard they won two
matches in a row."
messages.650:
"I heard the Miko Club had something to do with their
prowess."
messages.720:
"I've heard of that too. A victory prayer, wasn't it? It
sure seems to have worked."
messages.778: The words fell sharply into my ears.
messages.828:
Of course, for the baseball club to win not once, but
twice...
messages.906:
Everyone thought they were useless, but now they're actually
making a name for themselves.
messages.962: How much of that was really down to Tamaki, I wonder.
messages.1009: Well, as long as it's not ill-intentioned.
messages.1100: Within all this gossiping by people..
messages.1123:
How many of them are actually able to see Tamaki for the
kind of person she is?
messages.1179:
Her kindness, her cuteness, her strengths and weaknesses,
are there anybody who's actually interested in that?
messages.1331: Suginami patted me on the shoulder as he spoke.
messages.1389: "I want her to look for something for me..."
messages.1453: Knowing him, it'd be something completely stupid.
messages.1545:
"There was a map that was handed down the Suginamis from
generation to generation, but lost to the sands of time..."
messages.1678: "I'd ask her to help me see it next time."
messages.1758: I lost my words, and just let out a heavy sigh.
messages.1811: "It must've been a treasure map, so..."
messages.1842: "What the hell do you think Tamaki is?"
messages.1945: I started to pack my bag, deciding that ignorance is bliss.
messages.2022:
There's so many people who see Tamaki as little more than a
useful tool.
messages.2090:
Even if it makes me everyone's enemy, I'd protect her from
them.
messages.2154: I made that a vow, in my heart.
messages.2225:
The Miko Appreciation Club was my destination, to check up
on Tamaki.
messages.2287: I said as I opened the clubroom door.
messages.2337:
It wasn't just Tamaki inside, but 5 other girls clad in Miko
costumes as well.
messages.2485:
At the sound of her voice, all 5 of the Miko swung their
kendo pole downwards.
messages.2553: None of them seem to have noticed me.
messages.2640:
Seeing those kendo poles swung up and down brought a feeling
of happiness to me.
messages.2722: All the Miko with their pure white legs...
messages.2765: I was unable to do anything but stand and stare slackjawed.
messages.2819:
I didn't want to be a bother, but I didn't want to stop
watching either.
messages.2862: This is a bit of a problem...
messages.2893:
I smiled wryly to myself, tasting heaven and possibly
tasting hell.
messages.2978: Tamaki eventually noticed me, and smiled.
messages.3041: "I am giving them an explanation on purification."
messages.3130: I really should stop interefering in that case.
messages.3184: Although deep down, I wanted to keep watching...
messages.3225:
The population here was a bit too much to include me as
well.
messages.3252:
I knew there were three members, but it seems that some
people joined, or people outside the club were interested.
messages.3340: "Ah, I have things to do, I better hurry off."
messages.3459: I exited the room, closing the door behind me.
messages.3494: With so many women there, I felt out of place.
messages.3598: While thinking, my feet led me to the courtyard.
messages.3704: Kotori was there, sitting on one of the benches.
messages.3805: She seemed to have been engrossed in her library book.
messages.3877: "You're a real bookworm, even reading after school, huh?"
messages.3908: Kotori quickly shut her book tight, slightly embarassed.
messages.4060:
"I figured we'd go home together after her Miko Club ends
for the day."
messages.4209: Her playfulness was starting to make me blush.
messages.4346: ...I wonder what we really are doing.
messages.4365: We go home together and try to do things together often.
messages.4406:
We've even done... things... and there's definitely a deep
closeness between us.
messages.4490:
But... isn't there something else needed for us to be
considered together?
messages.4562:
But even though that may be true... it'd be more correct to
say we are, than to say we aren't.
messages.4638: We're definitely special in each other's lives.
messages.4712:
After a lot of thought, I answered her inquiry
affirmatively.
messages.4804:
Kotori smiled, one that seemed to have a deep meaning behind
it.
messages.4996: "But I'm sure she has a lonely side too."
messages.5056: Kotori's words made my heart skip a bit.
messages.5097:
Her own smile showed she was completely unaware of my
palpitations.
messages.5168:
"I mean, with the power she has, it's hard for her to trust
people, I'm sure."
messages.5283:
It doesn't seem like anyone's able to see Tamaki for who she
really is.
messages.5389: "Asakura-kun, you have to be good and strong for her."
messages.5436: She said, as she patted my shoulder.
messages.5528: She read us as if we were a pair of open books.
messages.5588: And she seemed to know about Tamaki's power too.
messages.5625: With a giggle, Kotori went back to the book she was reading.
messages.5700:
Just maybe, I don't know as much about Tamaki as I thought I
did...
messages.5896:
When I went to check up on the Miko Appreciation Club, it
had already grown to 5 members strong.
messages.5952:
Deciding it was not the place for me, I killed time by going
to the courtyard, and meeting Kotori.
messages.6018:
Kotori wanted to know the relationship between Tamaki and I,
and I confessed we were Ndating.
messages.6082: She said that Tamaki's heart must definitely be lonely.
messages.6138: And that's why I must be good and strong for her...

messages.179:
Passing through a park on the way home, my steady walk
quickly came to a halt.
messages.243: ...My eyes had fallen over a couple in familiar uniforms.
messages.284:
The Kazami Academy main school boy's uniform, and the
attached school's girl's uniform.
messages.327:
I was slightly surprised as I got a better look at the
male's face.
messages.417:
One of my "worst friends", and an unknown girl from the
attached school, were standing beside the playground slide.
messages.511:
"He's really a bishounen, the scene looks like it was lifted
from a painting."
messages.548: A similar mood was drifting about in the air.
messages.604:
I took cover behind a nearby tree, and continued my
reconaissance.
messages.740:
The girl was blushing heavily, and fidgeting with
nervousness.
messages.828: "That's a real lowerclasswoman, she looks so innocent..."
messages.869: Moreover, she's pretty cute as well.
messages.902:
The silence continued for a short while, as the girl
hesitated slightly-- then finally opened her mouth.
messages.1068:
She shivered slightly from embarassment as she finished her
sentence. But the girl continued to convey her feelings.
messages.1204:
Still behind the tree, I nodded to no one in particular. I
probably look like a horrible person doing this.
messages.1294:
That Kudou, he's so enviable. Having such a cute and
innocent girl confess to him...
messages.1396:
We've always talked about the pains of not having a
girlfriend, but it looks like Kudou's days of bachelorhood
are ending?...
messages.1476:
But, as I turned back and primed my ears again, the words
Kudou uttered were far from what I expected.
messages.1677: I inadvertently leaned forward further, straining my ears.
messages.1708: What was that? What did he say? I must've heard wrong!?
messages.1798:
"I'm very happy to hear your feelings, but... I have someone
right now."
messages.1880: His words were soft, yet the rejection was clear as glass.
messages.1997: The girl was trembling, on the verge of crying.
messages.2187: "I, I'm sorry too... for calling you out so abruptly..."
messages.2257:
The girl bowed, then walked away, the tears streaming down
her face visible to all.
messages.2382:
I waited until the girl disappeared from my sight, then came
out from my hiding place.
messages.2576: My immediate attack quickly turned him around.
messages.2628:
"...Why did you reject her? You lied about having someone
right now, didn't you?"
messages.2708: I went straight for the heart of the matter.
messages.2745:
When he invited me to the movies, he said that he was
unattached.
messages.2811: To reject such a sweet, earnest girl by lying...
messages.2875: That's completely incomprehensible by anyone's standards.
messages.2916: If I knew that that was going to happen to that girl...
messages.2996: ...Then maybe I wouldn't have wanted to watch.
messages.3063: "... I... have someone I like right now."
messages.3106: Kudou answered my accusation in a slightly embarassed tone.
messages.3172: Ahh, I see. So that's why he rejected her.
messages.3217: In that case, it can't really be helped.
messages.3250: Remembering Suginami's words before, I asked.
messages.3429:
Kudou tilted his head in question. An answer that neither
confirmed nor denied anything.
messages.3524: His innocence gave me the impression that it was wrong.
messages.3606:
"No, nothing... Suginami mentioned it before, so I
thought..."
messages.3682: As I talked, Kudou laughed out loud.
messages.3751:
"Stupid, you should know that idiot treats every rumour as
gospel."
messages.3842:
That was something I definitely agreed with. But if that's
the case, then who's this person he likes?
messages.3926: I can't think of anyone else who might fit the bill...
messages.3971:
"...Then, who is it that you like? You should just confess
already."
messages.4037: I elbowed him in the ribs as I asked.
messages.4155:
A small smile creeped onto his face as he opened his mouth
again.
messages.4245: "....The one I said that I liked... it's you, Asakura."
messages.4336:
What the hell? My face flushed bright red as I looked at
him.
messages.4402: Who likes who likes who now?
messages.4437:
My brain went into high-speed trying to figure out what
happened.
messages.4520:
...Several seconds after, not being able to keep it in
anymore, Kudou burst out in laughter.
messages.4621: "Mmmph.... that face! You really believed me!?"
messages.4760:
That idiot was smiling as if everything was right in the
world.
messages.4830:
A huge weight was finally lifted from my shoulders, with my
face sweating like crazy.
messages.4884: "...Don't tell jokes that'd give me a heart attack."
messages.4919: I rubbed my forehead and warned him exhaustedly.
messages.4994:
"Ahahahaha... it's your own fault for trying to meddle in
other people's private matters."
messages.5096:
Kudou then said "later", waved to me in goodbye, and walked
off quickly.
messages.5197: In the end, I still didn't find out the important part...
messages.5281:
That crap about liking me... saying it with such a serious
face, I really believed him...
messages.5369: But, but we're guys after all...
messages.5439: His smiling face as he confessed continued to haunt me.
messages.5491:
...Yeah, his face really looks like a girl's. It's quite
beautiful...
messages.5561: "And his hair was waving in the wind..."
messages.5839:
While walking home from school, by chance, I stumbled upon a
female student confessing to Kudou.
messages.5917:
He rejected her because, as he told me later, he has someone
he likes.
messages.6001:
He also said, at my continued questioning, that "The one I
like is Asakura"...
messages.6077:
Despite it obviously being a joke, after that incident, I
couldn't stop thinking about him...

messages.199: I was lying on my bed, reading a comic book.
messages.259:
Although not a single thing I was reading was processed in
my brain.
messages.313: It's been 20 minutes since I've even turned the page.
messages.402: That question mark would not go away from within my head.
messages.439:
And that same scene came replaying over and over again
inside it.
messages.552: "....The one I said that I liked... it's you, Asakura."
messages.648:
His face was blushing slightly as he said that, with a
smile.
messages.731: "...What on earth is happening to me?"
messages.766:
When the actual thing happened, it was immediately followed
by "You really believed me?"...
messages.842:
But in my head, the scene kept on going back to the
beginning before it can reach that point.
messages.1106:
I gave up the pretense of reading the comic book, and shut
it tightly.
messages.1211: With a big sigh, I closed my eyes.
messages.1280:
Three seconds later, my eyes opened again to the sight of
the cream-coloured ceiling.
messages.1342: "That was nothing more than a joke."
messages.1383: That's right, that's why I should calm down.
messages.1414:
It's not Kudou's fault. Even if he was serious, I shouldn't
be acting like this.
messages.1490: Yeah, he's a good friend after all. I like him.
messages.1539: That is, I like him as a friend.
messages.1599: These feelings right now are unbelievable.
messages.1663: But, always thinking of him the way I am now...
messages.1779: As that word left my mouth, my chest tightened up suddenly.
messages.1878:
Abandoning my thoughts before they got any further, I
switched off the bedside lamp, and closed my eyes, forcing
myself to sleep.
messages.2127:
Kudou's confession when I confronted him would not leave my
head.
messages.2205: What on earth is happening to me...

messages.280:
It was lunch break. We were eating lunch as usual at the
courtyard benches, when Kotori abruptly brought up her
lament.
messages.384:
"Well, you know that I'm part of the choir. Our next
assignment is to visit an orphanage to perform for them..."
messages.518: "And... I was assigned to perform a solo part."
messages.672: "It's good... but it means I'd stand out."
messages.736:
"So since your responsibility is heavy, your mood is as
well?"
messages.811: "Weeell, that's part of it, but not all..."
messages.877: She placed her chopsticks down, and started pondering.
messages.946:
"How do you say it... I don't think I'm really suitable for
the part..."
messages.1053:
"In the choir, everyone, at their core, just really likes to
sing..."
messages.1127: "But it can't be helped. It's the difference in quality."
messages.1268:
"Ah, uh, sorry... I don't think that's right anyway, there's
definitely people there better than me."
messages.1350:
"In any case, you'd do fine. You're definitely good enough.
I guarantee it."
messages.1428: "...Not that my guarantees mean anything, though."
messages.1514: "Hehe, well, they just earned you a reward. Say ahhhh♪"
messages.1608:
"Thanks. I feel a bit better now that I've told you about
this."
messages.1714:
"Hey, by the way, what should we do for Golden Week? Where
should we go?"
messages.1796:
"Ahh, that's right. Let's see... the 6th is Koyomi-sensei's
wedding ceremony, right?"
messages.1873:
"Yeah. Ah, and also, the orphanage performance I told you
about is on the 5th. Besides those, I've got nothing
planned."
messages.1995:
"I know, let's go to some hot springs! We can cure ourselves
of our everyday fatigue, and refresh our mind and body!"
messages.2077: "...That doesn't sound like something for young people."
messages.2168: Kotori stuck out her lower lip, pouting a little.
messages.2195: I laughed slightly, finding that insanely cute.
messages.2244: "Nah, I know, lots of people do that. But, well..."
messages.2347:
"...If you'd go with me, I'd drop everything else to make
sure I go."
messages.2444: She looked up at me with red cheeks and dim eyes.
messages.2500:
I almost spontaneously nodded at such a persuasive sight,
but managed to stop myself in time.
messages.2556:
I started whispering in a clear voice, the reason for my
rejection.
messages.2612: "I don't have the money to travel."
messages.2842:
She giggled and put a hand on my shoulder. It was
essentially true, though...
messages.3067:
She happily said the name of the amusement park repeatedly.
In any case, looks like our GW is set.
messages.3154: "How about early in the morning of the 3rd?"
messages.3260: "Time to head back to the classroom."
messages.3338: Kotori stood up, then stared at my face.
messages.3407: "There's a bit of egg on your mouth."
messages.3436:
She wiped it off with her finger. It was from the egg
sandwich I had for lunch.
messages.3557:
She put the finger with the egg still on it into her mouth,
with her other hand pulling mine towards the classroom.
messages.3770:
Kotori was assigned to perform a solo part for a concert at
the orphanage.
messages.3852:
Kotori was feeling worried about it, but not for the reasons
that I thought, apparently...
messages.3920: We then decided what we were going to do for Golden Week.

messages.191:
It's lunchtime... and time to devour Tamaki's home-made
delicacies.
messages.249: She'd been really busy with the Miko Club recently.
messages.294:
When I last checked, it was 5 members strong, and apparently
more had joined since.
messages.343:
Despite it being an appreciation club, it was starting to
take up a lot of time.
messages.392: ...And that only made me admire her even more.
messages.433:
Despite how busy she is, she still makes sure to serve up a
portion for me, every lunchtime.
messages.497:
Not to mention, fitting that in along with her duties at the
shrine...
messages.546:
She probably wakes up early and precisely the right time
everyday...
messages.585: I still have a long way to go.
messages.610:
I have to be there as well, to support her and make sure she
has ease of mind through this period.
messages.676:
I headed out of the classroom, and down the corridor leading
to the courtyard.
messages.715: I passed by a large and gaudy poster on the way.
messages.762:
"Baseball Club Chalks Up Third Win! Champions Amagi Academy
Defeated!"
messages.826:
That victory prayer... it was so strong as to help the
perennial whipping boys win 3 in a row?
messages.896: It can't just be seen as a fluke anymore...
messages.943: Hmm, was it really the prayer's work...?
messages.978: It was hard to believe at first, but now...
messages.1023:
I wonder what other surprises are in store for the Miko Club
now...
messages.1151:
I thought about checking up on the Miko Club again, and saw
Tamaki on my way out of the classroom.
messages.1265: I called out to her back.
messages.1292:
Tamaki turned around, and a smile grew instantly on her face
as she recognized me.
messages.1462:
Tamaki was holding several of those poles meant for
purification.
messages.1560:
I gently shifted half of the poles she was holding onto
myself.
messages.1753: "They are all for the new members."
messages.1905: "Assuming no one joins today, we have 15 members."
messages.1996: When did it grow that much?
messages.2031: I knew the membership was increasing, but...
messages.2076:
Thinking back to the time where it first started, 15 was an
unbelievable number.
messages.2119:
At this rate, not only is "Miko Musume" plausible, but even
splitting them into different groups...
messages.2203: The producer in me started to plot.
messages.2270:
"It seems the sales of Miko costumes have boomed... as well
as the people wanting to be one."
messages.2385:
It's supposed to be to costume to show your servitude under
God...
messages.2457:
Apparently, Tamaki was going to give them a lecture on the
way of the Shinto today.
messages.2513: "Is it okay if I listen in? I'm kinda interested."
messages.2578:
"Most certainly. I would be happy to educate you on such
practices."
messages.2873: I took over the remaining ones that Tamaki was carrying.
messages.2953: "Thank you very much for your help."
messages.3005: We then went to the classroom.
messages.3057:
A short while later, the Miko Appreciation Club members
started entering continuously.
messages.3125: Tch, they're not wearing the costume today.
messages.3164: All of them, including Tamaki, were in the school uniform.
messages.3236: The figure of a Miko is really...
messages.3321:
I quickly destroyed the dream of wearing a Miko Costume
inside me.
messages.3375:
Tamaki was handing out the photocopies that she had made
earlier.
messages.3507:
The way she stands on that platform, it's hard to tell that
she's new at it.
messages.3569: ...She could easily be a teacher in the future.
messages.3606:
Everyone else in the classroom were dutifully reading the
printouts given to them.
messages.3676:
It still seems uncertain whether all these people have
hidden agendas for joining, though...
messages.3760: Tamaki, affirming that everyone was able to hear her,
messages.3898: She was giving it her all...
messages.3921:
Using easy-to-understand words and explanations, yet
explaining seriously. She always is, anyway.
messages.4003:
Unlike myself, who's always being a lazy smartass half the
time.
messages.4040:
Whether it's at a lesson, at a shrine, at club activities,
and probably even at love...
messages.4089:
I should mimic the rest of the club members here, and stop
that behaviour, but...
messages.4192:
I just stared at Tamaki, letting my feelings of love for her
overcome me.
messages.4298:
"A Miko must be the picture of purity, in both mind and
body."
messages.4356:
She cannot associate with others, and must live a life of
purity.
messages.4398:
I hadn't realized it till now... but Tamaki's supposed to be
one of those people too.
messages.4460: But we have been dating... and those things...
messages.4538:
The meaning of "purity" can be argued, but there's no
dispute that her virginity is no longer hers.
messages.4610: Her body and soul is supposed to be God's, but her heart...
messages.4647: A horrible thought entered my head.
messages.4682:
As if delivering the final blow, one of the new members
raised a question.
messages.4760: "Does that mean Miko cannot fall in love?"
messages.4863: The question stopped her in her tracks.
messages.4896: Her discomfort at the question was clear for all to see.
messages.4962: The female students all focused intently on Tamaki.
messages.5005: Her eyes fell upon me for a split second.
messages.5141: Tamaki stayed stock still and quiet.
messages.5276:
Seeing Tamaki's reticience, the quiet club members suddenly
broke out in heated discussion.
messages.5364:
Tamaki was left behind on the conversation, at the teacher's
desk.
messages.5411:
She seemed to be thinking of answering, but the shock was
still overcoming her.
messages.5491:
Thinking about it, it's not surprising that everyone was
worried.
messages.5538: Love is a very important thing for females.
messages.5579:
To them, a girl not in love is one who just passes
day-by-day boringly.
messages.5651:
If they had to forsake love to become a Miko... that'd be a
grave problem for them.
messages.5733:
Of course, none of them truly want to be Miko, so it
wouldn't be a huge thing...
messages.5823:
Most of them just seem interested in how good the uniform
looks on the.
messages.5946: Tamaki was desperately searching for an answer.
messages.5985: She was still at a loss for words.
messages.6018:
If she agreed with the girl's assessment, she'd be denying
her relationship with me.
messages.6092:
On the other hand, if she disagrees, then there's the
problem of her being a Miko.
messages.6144:
No matter what she answered, she'd be put in a difficult
position.
messages.6245:
I'm not even a member of this club, what can I say to calm
them down?
messages.6288:
If I try to bluff them, it'd probably just bite me back
later.
messages.6374: I was rendered completely helpless too.
messages.6437: The classroom door was opened wildly.
messages.6466: The entire class immediately looked in that direction.
messages.6503:
A male student was standing there, wearing the uniform of
the volleyball club.
messages.6585:
"Excuse me, um, I was wondering if you could... that victory
prayer..."
messages.6702:
Tamaki immedaitely headed to the hallway and began
discussing with the male student.
messages.6768: For the moment, the question seemed to have been delayed.
messages.6805:
Honestly, I couldn't imagine how she'd answer anyway. Either
way, she'd be pained...
messages.6889: But she can't run away from it forever, either.
messages.6936: Eventually, Tamaki returned to the platform.
messages.6990:
"My apologies, I shall be conducting a victory prayer. Those
who wish to observe, please come with me."
messages.7087: With that, she put the matter to rest.
messages.7122: And unsurprisingly, made a speedy exit from the classroom.
messages.7167:
The clamour and chatter immediately began within the
classroom.
messages.7208: I couldn't help but overhear some of the conversing.
messages.7276:
"So basically, if we're in the Miko Club, we can't be in
love?"
messages.7352: "Maybe... the head was stunned by that question."
messages.7407: "It'd get ugly for me if that was really the case..."
messages.7485: They were whispering, but loud enough for me to hear.
messages.7571:
Soon after, the rest of the club members went out to see
Tamaki perform the victory prayer.
messages.7651: I was left there, taking everything in.
messages.7866:
Tamaki was giving the 15-strong club members a lecture on
Shinto.
messages.7952:
Tamaki took pains to emphasize that Miko must be pure of
body and soul.
messages.8032:
The club members then asked whether that meant that Miko
cannot fall in love.
messages.8118:
The question shcoked Tamaki. Thanks to the good timing of
the Volleyball Club, she was able to avoid it.
messages.8217: How would she plan to answer it...

messages.199:
And then, our period of enjoyment came to an end. That's
been happening a lot recently.
messages.364:
It was a casual time. We were just talking about anything
that came into our heads.

messages.1968: His face exuded complete calmness, easing my worries.
messages.2055:
I took a seat on a chair next to the bed, and somehow or
other, started staring at Kudou's sleeping face.
messages.2148:
He's sleeping really well. I don't think anything I could do
would wake him up.
messages.2247:
Delicate-looking chin and cheeks with perfectly clear skin.
Long eyelashes bordering on the eyelids. So many of them...
messages.2408: Ahhh, no no! I almost lost my way down a dangerous path!
messages.2480: G, get a hold of yourself, Asakura!

I slapped my already-reddening cheeks to snap myself out of
whatever I was in.
