Kudou started talking incomprehensible gibberish in his
sleep.
messages.2913: In the middle of that nonsense...
messages.2997: Was that my imagination, or did he just call out my name?
messages.3088: I bended over his body, still lying in the bed.
messages.3165: Kudou's hands suddenly shot up, and firmly embraced me.
messages.3268: Kudou, still in dreamland, had a smile floating on his lips.
messages.3322: ...What the hell kind of dream is he having?
messages.3502: is this guy half-asleep or what?
messages.3537:
And now, he's trying to push my face closer to his. Wait,
what? What? WHAT?!
messages.3601: I started panicking too late to change anything.
messages.3653: Our lips met on top of one another.
messages.3748:
The only thing I could comprehend was the sweet citrus smell
in my naval cavity.
messages.3876:
My brain went numb, I could think of nothing at all. Just
feel those soft, tender lips on mine...
messages.3968: Ahh, so this is how a kiss feels like. How amazing.
messages.4129:
As I returned to my senses, I used alll the strength I had
to escape Kudou's death grip.
messages.4239: Kudou started talking in a sleepy voice, rubbing his eyes.
messages.4332: I was desperately gasping for air.
messages.4371:
I could feel my ears glowing bright red from that whole
experience.
messages.4471: He looked at me with curious eyes.
messages.4570: Calm down calm down calm down.
messages.4670:
Not getting any understandable response from me, his voice
grew more dubious.
messages.4785: He can't have not noticed such a thing, could he?
messages.4857: Yet, his face showed complete innocence.
messages.4980:
I released a long, long sigh. He really doesn't know
anything...
messages.5025:
"No... it's probably better if you don't know. I'd try to
forget it too."
messages.5095: I unconciously started rubbing my nose, as I replied.
messages.5187: "...Don't worry about it. Anyway, how are you feeling?"
messages.5238:
I changed the topic before Kudou could ferret anything out
of me.
messages.5303: "Ahh, I felt a lot better once I took some medicine."
messages.5402: Even I knew I was just rambling now.
messages.5497: Kudou smiled, his cheeks radiating with colour.
messages.5534: I mindlessly asked the first thing that came to mind.
messages.5579:
"Hahaha, let me guess, a dream where you kissed the one you
liked?"
messages.5649: His face suddenly turned red, as I hit the target.
messages.5854: I answered, my eyes gazing far into the distance.
messages.5889: "(And that was really... his dream... gahgahgah...)"
messages.5936: And I've lost my chastity to... that...
messages.5975: Ahh, this world really has no God.
messages.6018:
"...Since you've recovered now, hurry up and go back to
class already."
messages.6065:
I unsteadily got up and started heading out of the
infirmary.
messages.6102: I definitely didn't want to walk back together right now.
messages.6202: As I started to leave, Kudou called out to me.
messages.6274:
I answered with inside my throat, not able to turn around to
face him. I didn't want him to see my face now...
messages.6431: Simple words of gratitude straight from the heart.
messages.6514: I waved as I exited the infirmary.
messages.6574:
Compared to that completely unwitting Kudou, I've become a
damaged man, with feelings of guilt abound.
messages.6850:
Kudou, who had went to the infirmary earlier, never
returned. His condition must really be bad.
messages.6960:
I went to visit him in the infirmary, and somehow, the
sleeping Kudou stole my first kiss.
messages.7059:
Yet, when he woke up, he was completely clueless on what he
did.
messages.7123:
Even after he thanked me for my concern, I still harboured
feelings of guilt, exhaustion and resentment.

What was left of the school day passed by, and it was time
to go home...
messages.329:
And once school was no longer there to distract me, my
thoughts wandered back to the events in the morning. What a
headache.
messages.348:
Even now, I was lying on my bed, staring at the ceiling, and
thinking of that.
messages.386:
I can't even remember whether I ate anything, but since my
stomach isn't complaining, I probably have.
messages.540: I closed my eyes, and took a long breath.
messages.632: I unconciously brought my fingertip to my lips.
messages.773:
As if my subconcious was lamenting the theft of my first
kiss.
messages.804:
One could say that "There's nothing you can do about it",
but the sensation in my lips wouldn't fade so easily.
messages.851:
Kudou's female-like sigh, slender arms, and neither cold nor
warm, soft lips...
messages.913:
Although those words came out of my own mouth, I was still
astonished to hear them.
messages.1015:
My heart started beating furiously. My cheeks were slowly
turning red.
messages.1214: I have to stop lying to myself.
messages.1243: I rose from the bed into a sitting position.
messages.1303: I didn't like it, but I had to accept it--
messages.1379: "He's been on my mind the entire time..."
messages.1498:
It was strange coming out of my own mouth. But I couldn't
deny the truth of that statement.
messages.1517:
It all started at the park, when Kudou told me that "The one
I like is you.".
messages.1548:
At that time, my normal self was thrown for a loop, and a
door I had thought was shut firmly, was forcibly opened.
messages.1599:
Yet the feelings I got from behind the door aren't things
that I dislike...
messages.1622:
I knew this deep inside, and my cheeks easily showed the
proof as well.
messages.1768:
Such long eyelashes and tender cheeks, a bishounen that
shouldn't have been born a man. That I can agree to.
messages.1817:
Yet, even though he's very much "bi", the "shounen" is the
complicated part...
messages.1866: Since it's always used in reference to males...
messages.1901: That's right... he's a guy... that's why I...
messages.1994: I moaned, rubbing my head and hair vigourously.
messages.2121:
I kept repeating to myself, I like cute girls, trying to
force it into my mind.
messages.2140: Then, my anger started to build.
messages.2155: Why am I the only one who has to deal with these feelings...
messages.2213: Kudou himself doesn't have a clue about what he did.
messages.2297:
But that takes nothing away from the fact that he stole my
first kiss.
messages.2348: "The way it is, I can't stay quiet about it much longer."
messages.2369: Accept the crime, demand an apology... and...
messages.2435: "I can't say it!! I definitely can't talk about THAT!!"
messages.2550:
Tomorrow... how am I going to be able to face him
tomorrow...
messages.2777: And, why does my chest feel so strange...
messages.2822:
And Kudou has no idea of the troubles I'm going through
now...
messages.2882:
How am I supposed to face him tomorrow... I spent the whole
night worrying and thinking about things like that.

messages.228: I'd normally be heading to the Miko Club right about now...
messages.286: Recently, Tamaki's been getting more and more busy.
messages.327:
The membership just kept growing, and with only one person
fit to guide them...
messages.385:
Even after club activities end and the members go home, she
stayed to do other administrative work.
messages.449:
Of course, I've waited for her several times, but that's

messages.515: I've gotten a bit impatient myself a few times...
messages.594: I guess I'd just go home myself, today.
messages.631: I'd at least go to say goodbye though.
messages.664:
I slung my bag over my shoulder, and set my sights for
Tamaki's classroom.
messages.789:
I peeped in to the classroom, to find Tamaki in the middle
of seeing some girl's future.
messages.874:
She already has her hands full with the Miko Club, she
shouldn't be seeing other people's futures...
messages.944: But knowing her, it's something she can't help anyway.
messages.991: I waited for her future-seeing to end, and called out again.
messages.1060:
My voice reached her at the same time the female student
walked off.
messages.1164: Her ever-present smile spread across her face.
messages.1209: "Sorry, but I'd be going home ahead today."
messages.1272: "I see. I'm sorry for always making you wait."
messages.1454: It'll be a bit lonely, but it's for the best.
messages.1483: I'd just have to deal with it.
messages.1500: We can still go on dates, after all.
messages.1539:
I should concentrate on small things like that... thinking
too much about it would just worry me.
messages.1613: I walked back home without incident.
messages.1719: I took in a deep breath.
messages.1746: The television had nothing interesting at all.
messages.1802:
When I was trying to watch, my mind kept wandering to other
things.
messages.1888:
Even when I'm trying not to, she keeps on popping up in my
mind.
messages.2011: Her words wouldn't stop running around my head.
messages.2044:
I couldn't answer it, simply or otherwise, yet I couldn't
stop thinking about it.
messages.2125:
If I talked to Tamaki about this, maybe we could work things
out, but...
messages.2185: Right now, she's working so hard on her Miko Club...
messages.2245:
I want to support her with whatever she does. Which means, I
want to support the Miko Club.
messages.2309:
But even then... when I can't be with her, it feels so
lonely.
messages.2358: I won't say it's the thing I most want in this world, but...
messages.2416: I still want to see her, talk to her, every day.
messages.2465: Man, I'm still such a kid...
messages.2496:
All these little thoughts and worries cloud my mind too
much.
messages.2537: But I can't help it, she's such an important person to me.
messages.2611: Ahh~, if only things in life were more simple.
messages.2669:
I should be eating my dinner now, but I had no appetite
whatsoever, and it seemed troublesome.
messages.2741:
I guess there's some cup noodles or frozen food somewhere
around...
messages.2801:
I want to eat something that can make me feel the warmth of
humans...
messages.2844:
The memories of devouring Tamaki's cooking flooded back to
my mind.
messages.2877:
Why is it that whatever your loved one makes, always tastes
so good?
messages.2959:
In my mind, there isn't a restaurant around that can match
up to Tamaki's cooking.
messages.3058: I stuffed my face into a nearby cushion.
messages.3091: Should I just go to sleep...? But just then...
messages.3195: Who can that be, at this time of the night?
messages.3222:
I've been hearing stories about salesmen peddling their
wares even at night...
messages.3276: Probably since there's always someone home at night.
messages.3321:
Living alone is all well and good, but it also means there's
no one else to do stuff like this...
messages.3409: You never appreciate it until you lose it.
messages.3430:
I buried my head deeper into the cushion, trying to pretend
it never rang.
messages.3622: I pulled myself up, and walked towards the entranceway.
messages.3723: I didn't bother to hide the irritance in my voice.
messages.3850: "Wait there a bit, I'd open the door."
messages.3893: I hurriedly swung the door open.
messages.4040:
What are you doing here?"... I wanted to ask, until my eyes
travelled to her luggage.
messages.4094:
The uniform-clad Tamaki was holding two big bags of grocery
items.
messages.4186: "I know it is late, but... I wanted to see you..."
messages.4366: She smiled at me and asked.
messages.4395: "Err... n, no, not yet, at all..."
messages.4531: Just as I thought, those bags she was carrying...
messages.4597:
Noticing my stares, she brought the supermarket bags up
higher towards me.
messages.4695: "Um... would you like to eat dinner together?"
messages.4773: She did come over to make dinner for me...
messages.4810:
She probably went straight to the supermarket after club
activities, then came here...
messages.4913: Yet she still came here to see me...
messages.4980: She's way too cute and caring.
messages.5026: There's no point thinking too much unnecessarily.
messages.5461:
Tamaki politely removed her shoes, and entered the living
room.
messages.5494:
Anyone else who sees it might not think it's anothing
special,
messages.5566: But even this small little thing made me delighted.
messages.5601: I could feel the love for her inside me.
messages.5667: The beating within my heart is best known by me, after all.
messages.5776: I may not be sure how real it is,
messages.5833:
But one thing's for sure, she's a very important person to
me...
messages.5848:
Tamaki's cooking was just the phoenix down that my stomach
needed.
messages.5904: Tamaki's cooking is easily the best around.
messages.6157:
"Of course it was. Your cooking is the Number 1
Pick-Me-Upper."
messages.6326: "Where did you learn to make such delicious food?"
messages.6449: "It was mostly my mother who taught me."
messages.6498: She smiled in memory as she spoke.
messages.6530:
"She was skilled and knowledgable in cooking, even for the

The daughter succeeding the skills of the mother... it had a

messages.6800: I sure wish Nemu could've done the same thing.
messages.6858:
Speaking of her, I haven't really kept in contact with

messages.7030: "I have new things that I want to remember."
messages.7122:
"I mean, new memories... more than cooking because of
mother..."
messages.7350: Tamaki really loves me that much.
messages.7395: She's practically willing to devote her life to me.
messages.7420: I have to respond to her feelings.
messages.7521:
I swiftly held onto her by the shoulders, and closed the
distance between us.
messages.7556: And, just as I was about to kiss her--
messages.7692: Tamaki suddenly swung her head back.
messages.7748: "H, hey, are you having a headache again?"
messages.7826: ..She is. It doesn't seem as bad as the last time, though...
messages.7861: She started rubbing her forehead, her face stricken.
messages.8080:
"Are you sure you're feeling okay? Shall I bring you to a
hospital?"
messages.8233: If something ever happened to Tamaki... I...

messages.8356: "No, I don't mean it that way..."
messages.8407: She seemed to think I was criticizing her?
messages.8472: "O, of course, I was just very happy."
messages.8513: She hurriedly looked back up at me.
messages.8549: "Since you were so worried about me..."

messages.8670:
"You always put your heart into everything... and you've got
a lot on your shoulders as well."
messages.8873:
"--If you have free time sometime, let's go on another
date."
messages.8924: We haven't gone on one in awhile.
messages.8955: There's still a lot of places I wanted to go, with her.

messages.9072: "H, hey, I said already, don't strain yourself."
messages.9136:
But despite that, I couldn't help but smile to myself at her
behaviour.
messages.9181: She's so cute when she's so determined like that.
messages.9369: "Do you have any plans for Golden Week?"
messages.9466: Oh right, that's coming up soon.
messages.9497:
Usually, every year, my Golden Week consisted of renting
videos to watch all the way through.
messages.9569: This year didn't look like it was going to be any different.
messages.9598: After all, I hate doing troublesome things.
messages.9650: And travelling is the very definition of troublesome.
messages.9764:
"That's good... I asked, because the Miko Club will be
having a training camp then."
messages.9880: The club's gotten so big as to justify that now...
messages.9940:
"Yes. The normal things can be taught at school, but the
special rituals need a special location."
messages.10064: "I have arranged for a location near a waterfall..."
messages.10139: The image of Niagara Falls popped up in my head.
messages.10186:
Training at a waterfall like that... they're really serious
about it.
messages.10233:
Or if they want an even bigger challenge, there's the Kegon
Waterfall...
messages.10322: Miko really are an entirely different breed.
messages.10406:
I slapped my cheeks, pushing those stupid thoughts out of my
head.

messages.10575: "There'd be so many girls there... are you sure we can go?"
messages.10639: I tried to ask as calmly as I could, but Tamaki frowned.
messages.10737: "You wouldn't let girls carry all that luggage, would you?"
messages.10870: Even her pouting face is cute.
messages.10905: But the smile quickly returned to her face.
messages.10966: "...Honestly, I just want to spend more time with you..."
messages.11083:
She finished speaking, looking downwards and blushing
furiously.
messages.11125: No way I can resist her when she says it like that.
messages.11158:
The way she communicates her feelings so whole-heartedly, is

messages.11391:
Tamaki was always busy, so we couldn't spend any time
together.
messages.11453:
Worried about those feelings, that night, she came over to
my home to cook dinner.
messages.11537:
When I escorted her back to her house, she invited me to her
Miko Club training camp on Golden Week.

I'm a student, so I have no choice but to go to school in
the morning...

I wasn't able to sleep at all yesterday, so I ended up
coming to school later than usual.
messages.549:
Although I don't know whether it was entirely because of
that...

messages.755:
Even giving a reaction was tiresome, so I settled for a
one-word reply.
messages.851:
"Mm, is something wrong? You don't look charged up for the
morning."
messages.913:
Suginami was giving off an irritatingly-energetic aura, as
usual.
messages.964: "...Sorry, but I've never been a morning person."
messages.1020: I somehow managed to groan my answer out.
messages.1145:
That stupid laugh echoed endlessly in my head. Argh, I wish

messages.1251:
"But today, you're even more devoid of energy than usual.
Affairs of the heart, perhaps?"
messages.1366: His unexpected question shocked me into motion.
messages.1470: Suginami looked at me suspiciously, narrowing his eyes.
messages.1532:
"T... that's wrong!! Don't make half-baked guesses like
that..."

messages.1699: It's true, affairs of the heart are pretty normal.
messages.1746:
But considering the situation and the other person
involved...

I heard a slightly high-pitched voice. My body immediately
started stiffening up.
messages.1945: I could feel my own cheeks starting to redden quickly.

Completely unwitting of my complicated situation, Suginami
returned Kudou's greeting as usual.
messages.2227:
The way I threw up my hand in surprise, and how I replied,
made me sound like a robot.
messages.2305: I couldn't recognize where my own voice was coming from.

Kudou peered closer at my red face, his forelocks dangling
in front of my eyes.
messages.2557: This is the worst torture known to mankind...
messages.2618:
"...Oh! Don't tell me I passed my cold on to you... I'm
sorry."
messages.2692: "No, that's not it, that's not it at all!"
messages.2739: I hastily shook my head at the apologetic Kudou.
messages.2840: Suginami was watching us with great interest.
messages.2959: "No no no. Do't worry, I understand."
messages.3084:
"Nothing, don't worry, don't worry. I'm not prejudiced
against that kind of thing."
messages.3174: Suginami gave me a warm smile.
messages.3221:
That kind of thing... oy, what the hell are you thinking
of!?
messages.3307: "Watch over him, Kudou. It'd be for the best."
messages.3458: Suginami's words flew right over the clueless Kudou's head.
messages.3528: I struck my table with my fist in desperation.
messages.3682: Argh, why can't this bastard just shut up?
messages.3756:
Once he'd finished saying everything he wanted to, he
returned to his seat.
messages.3861: "Hey, what on earth was he on about?"
messages.3935:
I covered my red cheeks with one hand, pinching my nose with
it as well.
messages.4064: I quickly shoo'd away Kudou with my other hand.
messages.4125:
When Kudou finally returned to his desk, my chest felt that
tiniest bit lighter.
messages.4191: Goddamnit Suginami, stop saying those weird things.
messages.4273: In any case, it seems like Kudou still hasn't gotten it...
messages.4331:
He went back to his desk rather puzzled. I stared at his
back.
messages.4521: Where am I going to go from here...
messages.4733: The entire yesterday, I couldn't get my mind off Kudou.
messages.4809:
Lovesickness... but the crush is a guy. Suginami, seeing my
hesistance and nervousness in talking to Kudou, started
talking irresponsibly trying to "help" me.
messages.4918: Kudou was blissfully unaware as usual...
messages.4961: ...While I continued to have unwanted feelings.

Her singing voice, like the flower petals, flowed throughout
the forest.

Kotori was practicing her gift for her sister's wedding
ceremony.
messages.279:
Unlike the last time where they chose to perform a foreign
song, this time the song was purely Japanese.
messages.359: Her singing could easily bring tears to the sensitive.
messages.433: Kotori really is an amazing singer.
messages.502:
I close my hot eyelids, and let my sense of hearing take
over.

Some time after the song ended, Kotori emerged from behind

"I... guess so. All the lyrics are etched in my brain, I

"Yeah. From now till the day itself, it'd take a bout of

"That's exagerrating... besides, singing is one of the

"Let's see, the 3rd of May is in roughly one week. April

"But this time, you'd better make sure you don't fall sick

"...After what happened at the graduation party, that

"If that really were to happen again, I won't let you ride

Kotori ran away laughing, escaping from my jokingly raised

I eventually caught up with her, patting her hat with my

"The wedding ceremony is important, but the TDL is important

messages.2833:
Suddenly feeling lonely, my sigh disappeared into the sakura
park.
messages.3045:
Kotori was singing a song. Her singing voice left a deep

messages.3174: I'm sure Koyomi-sensei would be pleased by it.

messages.219: The teacher's voice could not penetrate my head.
messages.258:
I could see the white words written on the blackboard, but
that was all my brain would process.
messages.318:
Lately, my mind has been concentrating on just one certain
matter.
messages.386:
Of course it wouldn't think about anything else, only the
one thing I can't change...
messages.485: I took a quick glance at Kudou.
messages.547:
His little habits, way of talking, what he laughs at and
gets angry at...
messages.619:
THinking about those things so much, made the time pass by
quickly.
messages.702:
A little part of me wanted to know his answer. Yet I was
scared to find out.
messages.774: So all I could do was think.
messages.793:
Having my first kiss stolen by a guy... yet ending up
falling in love with him...
messages.873: That's such a laughable thing to happen.
messages.965: That's why I can't let anyone know.
messages.1076: The last bell rang throughout the school.
messages.1107:
Just thinking about things like that made an entire school
day pass by.

I needed a change of pace. I decided to walk through the
Sakura Park back home.

The wind scattered the sakura petals. The sakura petals that
would not die...

I leaned against one of the many trees, and gazed at the
dancing, fluttering sakura petals.
messages.1495: "...He said he liked sakura trees in leaf."
messages.1536: But this island hasn't ever seen them.
messages.1577: I felt a twinge of regret inside me.
messages.1635:
When I noticed it, I couldn't help but smile bitterly to
myself.
messages.1680: Even now, I was still thinking of him.
messages.1828: I waved to her when I saw her.
messages.1947: I'm not just doing that though...
messages.2020: "Asakura-kun... you've been in deep thought a lot lately."
messages.2063: She looked at me, her worry evident.
messages.2108: "You realized? I've been having the new-school-year blues."
messages.2147:
I spread my arms wide in gesture, as if that explained

withered, didn't you?"
messages.8041: Silence. In this case, it probably meant that I was correct.
messages.8113: "...What kind of change happened in you?"
messages.8169: "...Like the ones that happened to you?"
messages.8247:
"...Right. I lost my power to produce wagashis... what about
you?"
messages.8510: "To put it simply... it was telepathy."
messages.8574: "...Really? You really had such a power?"
messages.8683:
An honest question, and an honest response. It was hard to
believe that, but...
messages.8749: --How else could she know about my wagashi power?
messages.8794: The question continued to echo around my brain.
messages.8866:
If what she said was true, how many times had she had to
face unpleasant thoughts?
messages.8932:
The human mind is filthy, and can think up painful -- no,
beyond painful -- things that we would never say out loud...
messages.9066:
She knew what people were thinking. No one on earth could
imagine a mere human posessing such a power.
messages.9163: "That power had always been convenient for me..."
messages.9244:
"Because... if you know what the other side is thinking,
what the other side wants, the relationship would go
smoothly."
messages.9381: "...And when I understood, I could be happy myself."
messages.9479:
I recalled that dream I saw sometime back. What did Kotori
wish for in it?
messages.9560: Kotori had wished for that wholeheartedly.
messages.9656: "That power was really like a great present to me..."
messages.9739: "I easily got close to my family."
messages.9789: "A new class, and new classmates, were no problem at all."
messages.9887:
"...I knew who were the people who truly loved me for who I
am."
messages.10002: Her confession made something deep inside my chest ache.
messages.10059:
When you know, you have peace of mind. On the other hand, if
you don't know, you become anxious.
messages.10229: "And I knew... that you loved me."
messages.10308:
"That's why I could love in return. Mik-kun, Tomo-chan, and
you."
messages.10507: "And so, you're insecure about it now?"
messages.10574:
"There's not really... anything to be insecure about,
right?"
messages.10632: "When I was little, I was always smiling."
messages.10707:
"I didn't want to be disgreeable, didn't want to be a
bother. So when I felt sad, or felt angry, I just smiled..."
messages.10834:
"If you don't get angry when you're angry, or cry when
you're sad, no one will know either way."
messages.10912:
"When that happens, it becomes like a swamp, slowly
swallowing you with each step you take..."
messages.11036:
"You're right... that's when I realized I had the power --
the power to read minds. The telepathy I mentioned earlier."
messages.11184: "In the end, I needed that to get over that phase until..."
messages.11285: That power really was a good present to her. Therefore...
messages.11355:
"When you lost it, of course you were worried about whether
it'd come back, and what you'd do without it."
messages.11465:
"...It was because of that, that you were having headaches
before, right? When you read people's minds, your head
aches?"
messages.11634:
"...Did you know that I have another power besides the
wagashi one?"
messages.11717: "No... I wasn't able to see it..."
messages.11791:
"I'm able to see what other people are dreaming... not very
similar to telepathy, no."
messages.11958:
"Even if I didn't have that power, I would still have fell
in love with you."
messages.12030:
"Love is love. There's no need for reason or proof for it to
exist."
messages.12148:
"...Kotori. You were lying when you said you didn't like
singing, weren't you?"
messages.12292: "...No. I really don't like to sing..."
messages.12339:
"You really only sang in order to escape telepathy for a
short while?"
messages.12457:
"Why would people get so absorbed into something that they
don't like to do?"
messages.12550: It's always sad to see sakura petals wither away.
messages.12595: But that is nature's ordinary path.
messages.12630:
When the sakura petals followed it's ordinary path and
wilted, we experienced extraordinary situations ourselves.
messages.12712:
That is experience. When we lose something the first time,
the reaction may be strong, but we become accustomed to it
with time.
messages.12800: It isn't a hard thing to understand.
messages.12880: "This is the conclusion I've come to."
messages.13014:
"Proof that you love someone, proof that that someone loves
you."
messages.13088:
"Although there's normally no way to get that proof, for
you, it came naturally. You became used to it."
messages.13270:
"The first time you started singing, was when your mom
advised you to do so, right?"
messages.13353:
"Y, yes... mother... mother was never able to enter a choir
herself."
messages.13442:
"I didn't really want to, but... I just smiled and
nodded..."
messages.13514: "Then that's even more the case, definitely."
messages.13561: "Your love of singing simply didn't have any proof to it."
messages.13677:
"However, that made you uncertain. You've always had proof
of the things you like. That's why..."
messages.13801: "I, I hate singing...? Don't I think that...?"
messages.13865:
"If you really like something, there's no need of proof for
it."
messages.13986:
"There's no magical warranty that tells you what people
like, Kotori."
messages.14129:
"In this normal world, we still choose to like and love what
we feel we should."
messages.14317:
"But because we don't have telepathy, we can't see each
other's dreams, all we can do is communicate our feelings."
messages.14449:
"I, I can't... do that... it's so... scary... and
painful..."
messages.14537: "...Hm. Guess I have no other choice."
messages.14598: "If you can't understand from my words..."
messages.14855:
"And you can't understand my words... then I had to show you
by actions."
messages.14947:
"I understand your anxiousness. You've always had that power
to rely on."
messages.15025:
"But you'd be fine. Experience it all, experience. There's
no need to think so deeply about it."
messages.15105:
"It's a normal and uneasy world, but you're not alone in
it."
messages.15167:
"I'm here, your family is here. You have your best friends
as well. There's no need for proof, they're all people who
love you."
messages.15330:
"Good, that's a good smile. That's the smile of the real
Kotori."
messages.15388:
I wiped away her tears, seeing her smile from the bottom of
her heart.
messages.15444:
I may not have proof that she was doing so. But I believe
it.
messages.15495:
"Anyway, let's go. We talked for a long time... we'd have to
hurry a little now."
messages.15592: I took Kotori's hand. She started tottering unsteadily.
messages.15646:
She uncertainly took a step. But no matter how unsteady, it
was her first step.
messages.15741:
"The wedding ceremony, of course... You have to sing your
song for Koyomi-sensei, right?"
messages.15863: "There's not enough time? It's fine, Kotori."
messages.15914:
I gradually increased our speed. Our footsteps, pounding
onto the ground, were in unison.
messages.15996: "Whether we'd make it in time or not, I don't know. But..."
messages.16064: "--There's no need for proof like that!"
messages.16111:
As long as we're walking together like this, something like
that isn't needed.
messages.16411:
Koyomi-sensei called my cell phone. She told me that she
hadn't seen Kotori all morning.
messages.16491: Today was her wedding ceremony too...
messages.16534:
Koyomi-sensei was different from usual. At the sound of her
weak voice, I promised to bring Kotori to the wedding
ceremony location myself.
messages.16657:
Sakura Park -- as always, the same. I followed Kotori's
singing voice, the one I fell in love with every time I
heard it.
messages.16752: But this isn't where she should be singing.
messages.16797:
With the tree trunk seperating our backs, Kotori confessed
everything to me. Kotori's power was the ability to read
people's minds...
messages.16875:
She started crying at the insecurity of it all, but I kissed
her.
messages.16939:
In order to teach her that since she couldn't tell by
reading my mind anymore, there's no need for proof that
people really love each other.

messages.264: My eyes opened before the alarm clock rang,
messages.299: That's the first time this had happened.
messages.336: I was too excited at the prospect of seeing Tamaki.
messages.418: I got up, and changed into my school uniform.
messages.544: There were so few students at school.
messages.577:
The only people who would come now are the ones with club
activities anyway.
messages.645: An admirable show of dedication, I suppose.
messages.666:
The clubs suddenly reminded me of the situation with the

It'd break her heart when she finds out that most of the
members quit.

Maybe it's better to let her find out when she walks into
the clubroom herself.

It's partly my responsibility as well, since I was the one

As the meeting time drew closer, Tamaki was still nowhere to
be seen.

It'd be nice to give her the line she always gives me, about

She'd almost always show up exactly 5 minutes before, but

"Huhhh, what are you doing here so early? You're going to

Miharu punched her palm with her fist, in a burst of

messages.1843: "It's that girl who can control time, right?"
messages.1897: Miharu's guess completely flew over my head.
messages.1979: "That girl that can see the future, Konomiya-senpai!"

messages.2173: A little grin formed up Miharu's face.
messages.2230:
"Hmm, I see. I hate being a third wheel, so I'd head off.

The relationship between Tamaki and I seems to be well-known
now.

messages.2554: Now that I think of it, she's only been late once before.
messages.2599: When she was suffering from poor health...
messages.2646: Could it be that she's not fully recovered?
messages.2685: Or maybe she met an accident on the way...
messages.2757: There's nearly no traffic at this time of the day.
messages.2929:
It was illogical, but I couldn't give up hope till I saw it

messages.3111: I approached a nearby male student.
messages.3156: "Hey, has Konomiya come to class yet?"
messages.3212: He took a quick glace at Tamaki's desk.
messages.3319: An uneasy feeling started to creep into me.
messages.3342: Did something really happen to her?
messages.3379: I ran off, and back towards where we'd promised to meet.
messages.3561: I dashed up the stone steps as fast as I could.
messages.3588:
I put all my pent-up feelings into energy as my feet pounded
into the steps.
messages.3637:
The higher and higher I went, the more it seemed like the
steps would never end.

After what seemed like ages, I finally caught sight of the
shrine.

Breathing heavily, and heart racing, I entered the shrine
grounds.

messages.3941:
But I didn't see her on the way to school or back, so she
must still be at the shrine.
messages.3997:
As I thought more about it, the bad feeling in me grew
larger.
messages.4044: I started to search the grounds.
messages.4073: The kozue tree, the fountain, the hall of worship...
messages.4114: Finally, I checked the shrine office.

messages.4255:
I hurriedly thew my bag onto the floor, and grabbed her
shoulders.
messages.4304: She seemed to be unconscious, and didn't notice my touch.
messages.4360: "Oy, get a hold on yourself, hey!"
messages.4399: I slapped her cheeks lightly, but there was no response.
messages.4512: I hurried over to the phone, dialing 119 as fast as I could.
messages.4559:
"Hello!? Please send an ambulance over immediately! It's an

messages.4647:
I desperately explained to the receiver about Tamaki's
condition.
messages.4694:
Although I didn't know how to explain what she was going
through clearly.
messages.4785: The siren of an ambulance became audible.
messages.4826: The first-aid people carried Tamaki onto a strecher.
messages.4873:
They took her pulse and asked me questions about her
condition, but I couldn't answer accurately.
messages.4972:
I tried my best to remain calm, but my head was running
circles, not helped by the siren blare.
messages.5050: Tamaki was quickly carried into the ambulance.
messages.5140: He urged me onto the ambulance.
messages.5185: Inside, I frantically tried to talk to her.
messages.5261:
They had strapped an oxygen mask over her mouth, making her
silent breathing apparent.
messages.5323:
The beeping of machinery around revereberated around my
head.
messages.5395: I grasped her hand tightly, calling out to her.
messages.5444:
As my shout disappeared into the air, I hoped that it didn't
fall on deaf ears.
messages.5549: She was in such a deep state, she looked just like a doll,
messages.5627: My grip on her hand tightened.
messages.5654: My throat was dry and parched, making my voice hoarse.
messages.5744: Why did this have to happen...!
messages.5777: My anger at my uselessness slowly built up.
messages.5841: I brought her hand up to my face.
messages.6060: Tamaki didn't meet me where we promised in the morning.
messages.6099:
I searched for her at the shrine, worried, and saw her lying
on the floor, unconscious.
messages.6146:
I hurriedly called for an ambulance, and rode with her to
the hospital.
messages.6204: Why did this have to happen...

But as a beautiful singing voice reached my ears, my eyes

She couldn't say anything to Koyomi-sensei earlier.. the
things she wanted to tell her.
messages.494: She couldn't put it simply in words.
messages.539: She didn't know what would be right to say.

messages.671:
She may have gotten the impression that she didn't like
singing, but this made me certain that she really does love
it.
messages.733: It's not a matter of the lyrics.
messages.812:
It's the fact that Kotori is singing this for Koyomi-sensei.
That's the most important part.
messages.874:
Kotori didn't take her eyes off Koyomi-sensei, and

messages.948:
Kotori's singing was gently wrapping the two of them
together...

There was a light applause it first, quickly followed by

The wedding ceremony was one of those open-types, so it

messages.1295: Kotori seemed lost at what to do about the clapping.
messages.1328: I smiled at her cute reaction.
messages.1373: "At least respond by raising your hand, eh?"
messages.1575: Thank you~, she said, as she waved her hand.
messages.1731:
"Oh well, that's how it is. Your song was so moving, it

messages.1811: "Of course, it did so for me as well."

Standing among the crowd, the wedding dress-clad
Koyomi-sensei rushed towards Kotori.
messages.2187: "There's a lot I want to say to you..."
messages.2273: "...Yeah, you do. That you're angry with me, and..."
messages.2443:
"I ran away from your once-in-a-lifetime wedding ceremony,

messages.2612:
Koyomi-sensei said fiercely. Kotori, with an astounded

messages.2740: "Don't worry about that. I don't care about that..."

messages.2981: "And sang... for me... made me happy..."

"So happy that I can't describe it... that's why... that's

messages.3233: "Thank you Kotori... thank you so much..."

With those final words, the only sound that could be heard

messages.3357:
Her emotions seem to have gotten through to Kotori, at

messages.3453: Something in Kotori's eye was sparkling as well...
messages.3614: "Me too... I really love you too..."
messages.3661:
The rest of us clapped lightly at the beautiful scene before
us.
messages.3841: ◆The Singing Princess of the Wedding Ceremony◆
messages.3888:
Kotori's beautiful singing voice echoed around the wedding
ceremony.
messages.3935:
There was no need for words. Everything that she wanted to
convey to Koyomi-sensei was in her gentle song.
messages.4011:
In the middle of the unending applause, the two of them
embraced, tears falling from their eyes.

messages.196: I said in a low voice.

It was now well after the time when Koyomi-sensei embraced

The crowd was baying for an encore, so we snuck out of the

"Hehe... yeah. It's the first time I've seen her cry so

We held hands, as we walked slowly down the shopping
district.

May's weather was quite sunny, so the people walking down

messages.694:
The changes that occured with the changing of seasons was
occuring before my eyes.
messages.789: "It was when I was just a kid."

messages.1042:
She talked with a nostalgic look on her face. Of course,

Her fingers held my hand tighter, her arm moving closer to

I suddenly let go of her hand, then put my arm around her

Our walking speed was quickly mixed up, and her face ended
up on my shoulder.
messages.1637: "No reason to. Let's just walk slowly."
messages.1703: "We have plenty of time, after all."

Kotori strongly nodded her head. We continued with our
人-shape walking.

"I was cowardly... that's why I wanted it. But in the end,

"There isn't a person alive that doesn't have any cowardice

messages.2238:
"And even if you call yourself cowardly, I am too, just as

"I don't have telepathy anymore. I can only rely on words

She then invited me to a gathering with her relatives, and

messages.4231: "A confession of love for our future."

"Isn't there... anything I can do to help you? C'mon,

I gently caressed her fair cheeks, so soft and warm on the

I can't say I know the exact details... but it's like
exchanging engagement gifts.
messages.3891: In short, it's like Kanae and I getting engaged...
messages.3961:
Realizing just what kind of position I was one, I started to
blush deep red.
messages.4000:
"I don't really know whether this present will go over well
at this time of the year either..."
messages.4056:
Looking at the bag dangling from my hand, Kanae's smile grew
even wider.
messages.4121:
"I love Sakuramochi! I'd ask grandmother to make her tea,
and the three of us should eat it together."
messages.4291: There's no doubt what I like better, though.
messages.4338:
...And I couldn't say that for fear of being even more
embarassed.
messages.4387: "Ah-, but I know absolutely nothing about tea ceremonies..."
messages.4453:
Just realizing it myself, I started scratching the back of
my head.
messages.4536:
"Don't worry, don't worry! I'd teach you everything you need
to know! Before you enter the tea room, you have to..."
messages.4655:
"Ahahahahaha! There's lots of time, so I'd teach you
slowly."
messages.4750: "--We have plenty of time left, after all!"
messages.4982:
Under the clear blue summer sky, Kanae and I, in full formal
dress, walked together.
messages.5031:
The one way that Kanae and I could be together... that was
to be her life partner, and live that way for the rest of my
life.
messages.5113:
Thanks to that, I was on my way to meet her family
officially. Kanae told me to just act normally, but I was
still full of nervousness.。
messages.5212: Watching me struggle, Kanae simply laughed radiantly.
messages.5249:
Under the blue cherry trees in leaf, we steadily walked hand
in hand.
